### GlyphWidths

```csharp
System.Collections.Generic.IList<System.Double> Datalogics.PDFL.Font.GlyphWidths { get; }
```

Retrieve the glyph width table for the font's single-byte encoding.

Returns the 256-entry glyph advance table in character-space units (1000 units per em). For the user-space width of character code `c` at font sizes:`widths[c] * s / 1000.0`.

The returned vector always has 256 entries; positions outside the font's defined encoding are filled with whatever advance the font reports for unmapped codes (typically zero or the missing-glyph advance). This API is therefore only meaningful for simple single-byte fonts — Type 1, TrueType with a simple encoding, etc. CID / Type 0 fonts need per-glyph measurement via MeasureTextWidth instead.

# FontCreateFlags Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/FontCreateFlags

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Flags for creating fonts. If you want to subset a font, set both the Embedded and Subset flags

## Values

- `Embedded = 1`: Embed the font. Create an embedded font. By itself, this will not subset the font.
- `Subset = 2`: Subset the font. If you want to subset a font, set both the Embedded and Subset flags. You must call Document.EmbedFonts() to actually subset the font. Both embedding and subsetting a font creates a CFF font.
- `DoNotEmbed = 4`: Do not embed the font. You cannot set both this and the Subset flags. Nor can you set Embedded.
- `EncodeByGID = 8`: Create a CIDFont with identity (GID) encoding.
- `DeferWidths = 16`: Wait to get the widths until later (this affects Type0 fonts only).
- `GIDOverride = 32`: Convert cp to gid with identity embedded.
- `ToUnicode = 64`: Create a ToUnicode CMap.
- `AllWidths = 128`: Supply the entire widths table (this affects Type0 fonts only).
- `EmbedOpenType = 256`: Embed an OpenType style font subset, if appropriate.

---

# FontFlags Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/FontFlags

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Bit masks describing font characteristics from the font descriptor.

These flags are defined in the PDF specification and provide information about the visual style of the font.

## Values

- `FixedWidth = 1`: All glyphs have the same width (monospaced font).
- `Serif = 2`: Glyphs have serifs (short strokes at the ends of main strokes).
- `Symbolic = 4`: Font uses a custom (non-standard) character set or encoding.
- `Script = 8`: Glyphs resemble cursive handwriting.
- `Standard = 32`: Font uses the Adobe standard Latin character set or a subset of it.
- `Italic = 64`: Dominant vertical strokes of the font are slanted (italic style).
- `AllCap = 65536`: Font contains no lowercase letters; lowercase input is mapped to uppercase glyphs.
- `SmallCap = 131072`: Font contains both uppercase and small-capital glyphs for lowercase letters.
- `ForceBold = 262144`: Bold glyphs are drawn with extra stroke width at small pixel sizes.

---

# FontRescanFlags Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/FontRescanFlags

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Flags controlling which font directories to rescan after initialization.

These flags can be combined with a bitwise OR to rescan multiple sources.

## Values

- `FontRescan_Files = 1`: Rescan only the files defined in dirList, plus those added with PDFLAddFontDirectories.
- `FontRescan_System = 2`: Rescan the system font directories.
- `FontRescan_All = 3`: Rescan both user-defined and system font directories. Equivalent to FontRescan_Files | FontRescan_System.

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form

```csharp
class Form : Element
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Element`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Element.md)

## Description

Represents a PDF form XObject.

This is not to be confused with a PDF fillable form; a Form XObject is an object outside the page content stream.

A form XObject is a way to group a number of PDF objects together, into a single container. A Form XObject can hold both text and images, and can be defined once within a PDF file and then reused multiple times in the same PDF, and across multiple pages.

**Referenced by:** [`Annotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Annotation.md), [`CircleAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/CircleAnnotation.md), [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md), [`FreeTextAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/FreeTextAnnotation.md), [`HighlightAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/HighlightAnnotation.md), [`InkAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/InkAnnotation.md), [`LineAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LineAnnotation.md), [`LinkAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LinkAnnotation.md), [`OCREngine`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OCREngine.md), [`PolyLineAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PolyLineAnnotation.md), [`PolygonAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PolygonAnnotation.md), [`Redaction`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Redaction.md), [`SquareAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/SquareAnnotation.md), [`TextMarkupAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/TextMarkupAnnotation.md), [`UnderlineAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/UnderlineAnnotation.md)

### BoundingBox

```csharp
Rect Datalogics.PDFL.Element.BoundingBox { get; }
```

The bounding box for this element.

The bounding box is a rectangle that is guaranteed to encompass the element, but it is not guaranteed to be the smallest box that could contain the element. For example, if the element is a Path that contains an arc, the bounding box encompasses the bezier control points, and not just the curve itself.

### IsCurrentlyVisible

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.Form.IsCurrentlyVisible(OptionalContentContext occ)
```

**Parameters**

- `occ` ([`OptionalContentContext`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentContext.md)): The optional content context to use for visibility state information.

**Returns:** `bool`

true if the form is currently visible.

Tests whether a form is visible in a given optional content context, considering the current ON-OFF states of the optional-content groups in the optional-content dictionary (OCMD) and the dictionary's visibility policy.

If the form occurs more than once within the content, this method only checks the visibility of the first occurrence of the form.

This method determines visibility without considering the visbility of the Content object that the form belongs to. To determine the visibility of a form while taking the Content's visibility into consideration, use the alternate version of this method.

# FreeTextAnnotation Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/FreeTextAnnotation

```csharp
class FreeTextAnnotation : Annotation
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Annotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Annotation.md)

## Description

The free text annotation allows a user to place text directly on a PDF page.

An ordinary text annotation appears in a pop up window, and is attached to an icon; it represents a note added to a PDF file, and can be opened for viewing, or closed. But a free text annotation always appears open on the page. A free text annotation can be included anywhere in a PDF file by specifying the location and the CallOutLine points.

**Uses types:** [`AnnotationFlags`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/AnnotationFlags.md), [`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md), [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md), [`HorizontalAlignment`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/HorizontalAlignment.md), [`OptionalContentContext`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentContext.md), [`OptionalContentMembershipDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentMembershipDict.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md), [`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md), [`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md)

## Constructors

### FreeTextAnnotation

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.FreeTextAnnotation.FreeTextAnnotation(Page page, Rect initialRect, string defaultAppearance)
```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `page` ([`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md)): The page to which the FreeTextAnnotation is added.
- `initialRect` ([`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md)): A rectangle specifying the annotation's bounds, specified in user space coordinates.
- `defaultAppearance` (`string`): The default appearance string to be used in formatting the text.

Create a new FreeTextAnnotation at the end of a page's annotation array. To create a FreeTextAnnotation and place it elsewhere in the page's annotation array, use the version of the constructor that takes an array position.

### FreeTextAnnotation

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.FreeTextAnnotation.FreeTextAnnotation(Page page, Rect initialRect, string defaultAppearance, int addAfter)
```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `page` ([`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md)): The page to which the annotation is added.
- `initialRect` ([`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md)): A rectangle specifying the annotation's bounds, specified in user space coordinates.
- `defaultAppearance` (`string`): The default appearance string to be used in formatting the text.
- `addAfter` (`int`): Where to add the annotation in the page's annotation array. To add the annotation to the end of the array, pass a value of -2 or use the alternate version of this constructor that does not take an index (this is generally what you should do unless you have a need to place the annotation at a special location in the array). Passing a value of -1 adds the annotation to the beginning of the array. Passing other negative values produces undefined results.

Create a new FreeTextAnnotation at a specific index in the page's annotation array.

The domain of the function.

Contains 2 * m elements, where m is the number of inputs to the function. Each successive pair of elements gives the minimum and maximum values for one of the inputs. Input values to the function are clamped to these minimum and maximum values.

# GoToAction Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/GoToAction

```csharp
class GoToAction : Action
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Action`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Action.md)

## Description

A go-to action can be executed in a PDF document.

A go-to action includes a hyperlink that, when clicked, takes the reader to a different place within the same document.

The action is linked to a bookmark within the document.

A remote go-to action includes a hyperlink that takes the reader to a destination in a separate document.

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md), [`ViewDestination`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ViewDestination.md)

- `namedDestination` (`string`): The destination name to store in the action's /D entry.

Construct a GoTo action that refers to a named destination.

The named destination is not resolved at construction time; the viewer looks it up in the document's /Names/Dests name tree (or /Dests dict) when the action fires.

# GraphicState Class

```csharp
class GraphicState : SystemIDisposable
```

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

The graphic state is an internal data structure in a PDF file.

The graphics state holds the parameters that describe graphics within that file.

These parameters define how individual graphics are presented on the page, including layers and transparencies.

**Referenced by:** [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md), [`Image`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image.md), [`Path`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Path.md), [`Shading`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Shading.md), [`Text`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Text.md), [`TextRun`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/TextRun.md)

**Uses types:** [`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md), [`ExtendedGraphicState`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ExtendedGraphicState.md), [`LineCap`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/LineCap.md), [`LineJoin`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/LineJoin.md), [`RenderIntent`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/RenderIntent.md)

## Properties

### DashPattern

```csharp
System.Collections.Generic.IList<System.Double> Datalogics.PDFL.GraphicState.DashPattern { get; set; }
```

The line DashPattern controls the pattern of dashes and gaps used to stroke paths. It is specified by a dash phase and then a series of elements of a DashPattern list. The DashPattern's members are numbers that specify the lengths of alternating dashes and gaps; the numbers must be nonnegative and not all zero. The dash phase specifies the distance into the dash pattern at which to start the dash. The elements of both the DashPattern List and the dash phase are expressed in user space units. This retrieves the DashPattern used by the Pattern list current graphic state.

### ExtendedGraphicState

```csharp
ExtendedGraphicState Datalogics.PDFL.GraphicState.ExtendedGraphicState { get; set; }
```

The ExtendedGraphicState associated with this GraphicState.

The ExtendedGraphicState can contain additional parameters such as transparency, blend mode, and overprint settings that are not part of the basic GraphicState.

### LineFlatness

```csharp
double Datalogics.PDFL.GraphicState.LineFlatness { get; set; }
```

The line flatness tolerance in the current GraphicState, corresponding to the i operator. Default is 1.0.

Flatness controls the maximum distance (in device pixels) between a curve and the flattened line segments that approximate it.

### LineJoin

```csharp
LineJoin Datalogics.PDFL.GraphicState.LineJoin { get; set; }
```

The line join style used by the current GraphicState, specifying the shape at the corners where consecutive segments of a path connect at an angle.

### MiterLimit

```csharp

```

The miter limit for line joins in the current GraphicState, corresponding to the M operator. Default is 10.0.

When two line segments meet at a sharp angle and mitered joins have been specified, the miter limit controls when the join is beveled instead.

# Group Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Group

```csharp
class Group : Element
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Element`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Element.md)

## Description

A set of elements to be used within a PDF document.

A Group represents objects in a content object, but it resides in memory.

Therefore the group has no state and is not represented in any way in a PDF content stream. When used in a Clip, a group is used to associate Text objects into a single clipping object.

**Referenced by:** [`Group`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Group.md)

**Uses types:** [`Clip`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Clip.md), [`ColorProfile`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/ColorProfile.md), [`Content`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Content.md), [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`ElementCloneFlags`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/ElementCloneFlags.md), [`Group`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Group.md), [`Matrix`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Matrix.md), [`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md), [`RenderIntent`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/RenderIntent.md)

# HighlightStyle Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/HighlightStyle

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Specifies the visual effect used when a link annotation is activated (clicked).

## Values

- `None = 0`: Do not highlight this link
- `Invert = 2`: Highlight by inverting the contents of the rectangle
- `Outline = 3`: Highlight by inverting the border
- `Push = 4`: Display the annotation as if it were being pushed below the page surface (like a button)
- `Toggle = 5`: Toggle: synonym for Push

---

# HorizontalAlignment Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/HorizontalAlignment

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Values

- `Left = 0`: Align content to the left edge.
- `Right = 2`: Align content to the right edge.
- `Center = 1`: Center content horizontally.

# ICCBasedColorSpace Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ICCBasedColorSpace

```csharp
class ICCBasedColorSpace : ColorSpace
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`ColorSpace`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ColorSpace.md)

## Description

Works with the ICC color space.

The International Color Consortium (ICC) developed the ICC color space in 1993 to serve as a universal standard for for printing or presenting content with digital devices, and across all operating systems and platforms.

The ICC color standard applies regardless the hardware or software involved, and is used to make sure that color images and text appear properly on a wide variety of platforms.

**Uses types:** [`ColorSpace`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ColorSpace.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md), [`PDFStream`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFStream.md)

## Properties

### Alternate

```csharp
ColorSpace Datalogics.PDFL.ICCBasedColorSpace.Alternate { get; set; }
```

An alternate color space to be used in case the one specified in the stream data is not supported (for example, by applications designed for earlier versions of PDF). The alternate space may be any valid color space (except a Pattern color space) that has the number of components specified by N. If this entry is omitted and the application does not understand the ICC profile data, the color space used is DeviceGray, DeviceRGB, or DeviceCMYK, depending on whether the value of N is 1, 3, or 4, respectively.


An array of 2 * NumComponents numbers [ min0 max0 min1 max1 ... ] specifying the minimum and maximum valid values of the corresponding color components. These values must match the information in the ICC profile. Default value: [ 0.0 1.0 0.0 1.0 ... ]

# Image Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image

```csharp
class Image : Element
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Element`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Element.md)

## Description

An image resource can either be an image XObject or inline image found in a page's content stream.

An Image Xobject is stored separately from the graphics content stream in a PDF, and so can be used multiple times in the document, even across pages. The image is described in the /Xobject entry in the resources dictionary on the PDF page.

Image size and resoultion: For images that are imported from raster image files, the design width and height are stored in the Image object's Matrix, in the A (width) and D (depth) Matrix members, when the image is imported. These are stored in PDF units.

To derive the effective resolution of an image imported from a raster image file:

Horizontal resolution: divide the Image Width by the Image's Matrix A member and multiply by 72 to scale to DPI (dots per inch).

Vertical resolution: divide the Image Height by the Image's Matrix D member and multiply by 72 to scale to DPI (dots per inch).

**Referenced by:** [`Image`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image.md), [`ImageCollection`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ImageCollection.md), [`OCREngine`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OCREngine.md), [`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md)

**Uses types:** [`Clip`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Clip.md), [`ColorProfile`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/ColorProfile.md), [`ColorSpace`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ColorSpace.md), [`CompressionCode`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/CompressionCode.md), [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`ElementCloneFlags`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/ElementCloneFlags.md), [`GraphicState`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/GraphicState.md), [`Image`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image.md), [`ImageData`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ImageData.md), [`ImageSaveParams`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ImageSaveParams.md), [`ImageType`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/ImageType.md), [`Matrix`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Matrix.md), [`PDFStream`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFStream.md), [`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md), [`RenderIntent`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/RenderIntent.md)

### LargeData

```csharp
System.Collections.Generic.IList<ImageData> Datalogics.PDFL.Image.LargeData { get; }
```

Gets the decompressed image data from very large images.

NOTE: This function is only supported in 64-bit, only if enough contiguous memory is available. The data size must exceed nearly 2GB, otherwise an exception is thrown and you would use the Data member instead to access the image data. The first members of the list returned contain a close to 2GB chunk of the data, but the last member containing the remaining data will be smaller in size. This facilitates retrieving the data in .NET and Java which have 2GB limits on object sizes.

# ImageCollection Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ImageCollection

```csharp
class ImageCollection : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

An image collection can hold multiple images, created from an image file.

The full set of images in the collection can be saved to a single image file, but only as a .tif image file. For any other file type (JPG, PNG, and so on), the collection can only be saved as one image object per file.

**Referenced by:** [`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md)

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`Image`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image.md), [`ImageSaveParams`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ImageSaveParams.md), [`ImageType`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/ImageType.md)

Create an ImageCollection from a Stream.

This allows an ImageCollection to be read from a Stream object. The Stream must be seekable. Suitable examples are FileStream and MemoryStream. The Stream must contain image data in the TIFF format.

# ImageSaveParams Class

```csharp
class ImageSaveParams : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Class that defines parameters for saving an image to a graphics file.

The parameters include the file type (such as PNG or JPG), compression, image quality, and gray scale.

**Referenced by:** [`Image`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image.md), [`ImageCollection`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ImageCollection.md)

**Uses types:** [`CompressionCode`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/CompressionCode.md), [`TIFFByteOrder`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/TIFFByteOrder.md)

## Constructors

### ImageSaveParams

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.ImageSaveParams()
```

*constructor*

Default parameters for saving an image to a file.

## Properties

### Compression

```csharp
CompressionCode Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.Compression { get; set; }
```

Gets the type of compression to be used in saving the image to a file.

### DisableAlphaChannelGeneration

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.DisableAlphaChannelGeneration { get; set; }
```

Gets whether alpha channel generation is disabled for the output image.

When false, RGB image data with a Mask will be combined as RGBA + Alpha Channel output (32-bit). When true, the Mask is not combined and the output is RGB (24-bit). This is only valid for TIFF and PNG output formats.

### HalftoneGrayImages

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.HalftoneGrayImages { get; set; }
```

Gets whether grayscale images are converted to halftone.

When true, converts 8bpc grayscale images to 1bpc (B/W) images using a 45 degree line screen set for 106lpi at 600dpi. Note this can only be set to true for an image of ColorSpace of DeviceGray.

### JPEGQuality

```csharp
int Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.JPEGQuality { get; set; }
```

Gets the quality of a JPEG output image.

### MonochromeThreshold

```csharp
byte Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.MonochromeThreshold { get; set; }
```

Gets the threshold for determining which bits are white or black for Monochrome output.

Note: this is only valid for TIF Images using G3 or G4 compression and HalftoneGrayImages must be set to false.

### RaiseExceptionIfNotUsableColor

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.RaiseExceptionIfNotUsableColor { get; set; }
```

Gets whether an exception is raised if the image color format is not natively supported.

When true, an exception will be raised if the image being saved is not in a format this graphic form can save natively. When false, the image will be automatically converted into a form that can be saved natively (generally DeviceRGB using the sRGB profile).

### ReverseGray

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.ReverseGray { get; set; }
```

Gets whether the GrayScale output is reversed.

Note this is only valid for an image with a DeviceGray Colorspace.

### TIFFBlackIsOne

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.TIFFBlackIsOne { get; set; }
```

Gets whether a TIFF file is photometrically reversed.

Note this is only valid for a 1-bit TIFF image with a DeviceGray Colorspace.

### TIFFByteOrder

```csharp
TIFFByteOrder Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.TIFFByteOrder { get; set; }
```

Gets the byte order used within the TIFF file.

This is only valid for TIFF output.

### TIFFCMYKAlpha

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.TIFFCMYKAlpha { get; set; }
```

Gets whether CMYK image data is combined with the Soft Mask in TIFF output.

Note: This is only valid for CMYK image data which has a Soft Mask; the output will be 40-bit.

### WriteSeparationColorsToTIFF

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.ImageSaveParams.WriteSeparationColorsToTIFF { get; set; }
```

Gets whether separation colors are written to TIFF using the Photoshop tag.

When false, separation colors will be converted to their alternate color space and rendered as RGB. When true, separation colors are output using the TIFF Photoshop tag.

## Values

- `Invalid = 0`: Indicates an invalid or unrecognized image type.
- `TIFF = 1`: Tagged Image File Format

- `PNG = 4`: Portable Network Graphic
- `GIF = 5`: Graphics Interchange Format

# Inclusion Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/Inclusion

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Specifies how to include a resource in a file.

## Values

- `OncePerDocument = 0`: Include the resource only once per file.
- `OnEveryPage = 1`: Include the resource on every page in the file.
- `Never = 2`: Never include the resource.
- `WhenNeeded = 3`: When needed.
- `ByRange = 4`: Include the resource for a specified range of pages.

# IndexedColorSpace Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/IndexedColorSpace

```csharp
class IndexedColorSpace : ColorSpace
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`ColorSpace`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ColorSpace.md)

## Description

Indexed color spaces are used to reduce the amount of memory used for processing images.

Indexed color spaces are used when a limited number of colors are needed.

Commonly, an image with an indexed color space can be one third the size of the same image with a standard color space, because the indexed image uses a smaller palette of colors.

**Uses types:** [`ColorSpace`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ColorSpace.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md)

## Constructors

### IndexedColorSpace

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.IndexedColorSpace.IndexedColorSpace(ColorSpace base_, int hival, System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Int32 > lookup)
```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `base_` ([`ColorSpace`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ColorSpace.md))
- `hival` (`int`): an integer that specifies the maximum valid index value. In other words, the color table is to be indexed by integers in the range 0 to hival. hival can be no greater than 255.
- `lookup` (`System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Int32 >`): a list of integers in the range 0..255. There must be m * (hival + 1) values, where m is the number of components of the base color space.

Create a Indexed color space.

# InkAnnotation Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/InkAnnotation

```csharp
class InkAnnotation : Annotation
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Annotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Annotation.md)

## Description

A type of annotation allowing a user to edit a PDF document.

Ink annotations in a PDF file allow a user to work with a PDF document displayed on a screen just as if it were on paper, such as scribbling notes in the margins, or circling or underlining text. These types of annotations require a stylus or pen used on a tablet device.

**Uses types:** [`AnnotationFlags`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/AnnotationFlags.md), [`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md), [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md), [`OptionalContentContext`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentContext.md), [`OptionalContentMembershipDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentMembershipDict.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md), [`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md), [`Point`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Point.md), [`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md)

Setting this property will attach the Annotation to an OptionalContentMembershipDict; it will then be associated with the OptionalContentGroups and be subject to the VisibilityPolicy and VisibilityExpression of that MembershipDict.

By setting this property to null, the Annotation is detached from any OptionalContentMembershipDict.

Tests whether an annotation is visible in a given optional content context, considering the current ON-OFF states of the optional-content groups in the optional-content dictionary (OCMD) and the dictionary's visibility policy.

This method determines visibility without considering the visbility of the Content object that the annotation belongs to. To determine the visibility of an annotation while taking the Content's visibility into consideration, use the alternate version of this method.

# InkTypes Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/InkTypes

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Specifies the ink type used for trapping purposes.

## Values

- `Normal = 0`: Normal ink type for trapping. This ink type is trapped normally.
- `Transparent = 1`: Transparent ink type for trapping.
- `Opaque = 2`: Opaque ink type for trapping. This ink type is not trapped except to another opaque.
- `OpaqueIgnore = 3`: Opaque Ignore ink type for trapping. This ink type is never trapped.

# LabColorSpace Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LabColorSpace

```csharp
class LabColorSpace : ColorSpace
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`ColorSpace`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ColorSpace.md)

## Description

A Lab color space is a CIE-based ABC color space with two transformation stages.

In this type of space, A, B, and C represent the L*, a*, and b* components of a CIE 1976 L*a*b* space. The range of the first (L*) component is always 0 to 100; the ranges of the second and third (a* and b*) components are defined by the Range.

**Uses types:** [`ColorSpace`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ColorSpace.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md)

## Constructors

### LabColorSpace

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.LabColorSpace.LabColorSpace(System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Double > whitePoint)
```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `whitePoint` (`System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Double >`): An array of three numbers specifying the tristimulus value, in the CIE 1931 XYZ space, of the diffuse white point. The numbers X and Z must be positive, and Y must be equal to 1.0.

Create a Lab color space.

The blackPoint defaults to [0.0, 0.0, 0.0].

The range defaults to [-100 100 -100 100]

### LabColorSpace

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.LabColorSpace.LabColorSpace(System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Double > whitePoint, System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Double > blackPoint, System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Double > range)
```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `whitePoint` (`System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Double >`): An array of three numbers specifying the tristimulus value, in the CIE 1931 XYZ space, of the diffuse white point. The numbers X and Z must be positive, and Y must be equal to 1.0.
- `blackPoint` (`System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Double >`): An array of three numbers specifying the tristimulus value, in the CIE 1931 XYZ space, of the diffuse black point. All three of these numbers must be non-negative.
- `range` (`System.Collections.Generic.IList< System.Double >`): An array of four numbers [ amin amax bmin bmax ] specifying the range of valid values for the a* and b* (B and C) components of the color space.

Create a Lab color space.

# LaunchAction Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LaunchAction

```csharp
class LaunchAction : Action
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Action`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Action.md)

## Description

A launch action launches an application or opens or prints a document.

**Uses types:** [`FileSpecification`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/FileSpecification.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md)

## Constructors

### LaunchAction

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.LaunchAction.LaunchAction(FileSpecification fileSpec)
```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `fileSpec` ([`FileSpecification`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/FileSpecification.md)): A FileSpecification representing the application to be launched or the document to be opened or printed by this action.

General constructor.

The action's target will be the path referenced in the FileSpecification parameter. If the path is absolute, the target path will also be absolute. If the path is relative, the target path will also be relative.

Generally, the FileSpecification should be associated with the same Document that contains the LaunchAction. (Both FileSpecification and LaunchAction objects are associated with a Document at creation time, and the association cannot be changed.) The LaunchAction will be associated with the same Document that the FileSpecification parameter is associated with.

If the action's FileSpecification is changed during program execution such that the FileSpecification is associated with a different Document than the LaunchAction, saving the Document that contains the action will create a copy of the FileSpecification in the Document that contains the action.

## Properties

### FileSpecification

```csharp
FileSpecification Datalogics.PDFL.LaunchAction.FileSpecification { get; set; }
```

The FileSpecification for this action.

Generally, the FileSpecification should be associated with the same Document that contains the LaunchAction. (Both FileSpecification and LaunchAction are associated with a Document at creation time.)

### NewWindow

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.LaunchAction.NewWindow { get; set; }
```

Whether the destination document should be opened in a new window.

By default, this flag is not present.

If the action's FileSpecification is not a PDF, this flag is ignored.

**Exceptions**

- `InternalError`: if the NewWindow flag has not been set on this LaunchAction.

# LibraryFlags Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/LibraryFlags

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Flags for initializing the library. Unless you require fine-grain control of the intialization process of the library there is no need to use LibraryFlags or you can specify the value of NoFlags.

## Values

- `NoFlags = 0`: No flag is specified.
- `IgnoreDefaultDirectories = 1`: Search for fonts ignore compiled in default directories
- `CheckSubFonts = 4`: Check for substitution fonts at toolkit initialization. If they are not found, return an error.
- `InitPDFEdit = 32`: Initialize PDFEdit if this is true.
- `IgnoreCurrentDirectory = 256`: Ignore the current working directory only when searching for fonts
- `DisableMemorySuballocator = 512`: Disable suballocation of memory.
- `PreferLocalFonts = 1024`: Prefer fonts loaded from directories other than those controlled by the operating system
- `InitFormsExtension = 65536`: Loads the Forms Extension dependencies, otherwise they are not loaded.

---

# LineAnnotation Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LineAnnotation

## Description

The line annotation displays a single straight line on a PDF page.

When opened it displays a pop-up window containing the text of an associated note, placed at specific x/y coordinates for starting and ending points of the line.

# LineCap Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/LineCap

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

The line cap style specifies the shape to be used at the ends of open subpaths (and dashes, if any) when they are stroked.

## Values

- `ButtCap = 0`: The stroke is squared off at the endpoint of the path. There is no projection beyond the end of the path.
- `RoundCap = 1`: A semicircular arc with a diameter equal to the line width is drawn around the endpoint and filled in.
- `SquareCap = 2`: The stroke continues beyond the endpoint of the path for a distance equal to half the line width and is squared off.

---

# LineEndingStyle Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/LineEndingStyle

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Values

- `Square = 0`: A square line ending.
- `Circle = 1`: A circular line ending.
- `Diamond = 2`: A diamond-shaped line ending.
- `OpenArrow = 3`: Two short lines meeting in an acute angle to form an open arrowhead.
- `ClosedArrow = 4`: Two short lines meeting in an acute angle as in the OpenArrow style and connected by a third line to form a triangular closed arrowhead.
- `Butt = 5`: A short line at the endpoint perpendicular to the line itself (a butt cap).
- `ReverseOpenArrow = 6`: Two short lines in the reverse direction from OpenArrow.
- `ReverseClosedArrow = 7`: A triangular closed arrowhead in the reverse direction from ClosedArrow.
- `Slash = 8`: A short line at the endpoint approximately 60 degrees from the line itself.
- `None = 9`: No line ending.

---

# LineJoin Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/LineJoin

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

The line join style specifies the shape to be used at the corners of paths that are stroked. Join styles are significant only at points where consecutive segments of a path connect at an angle; segments that meet or intersect fortuitously receive no special treatment.

## Values

- `MiterJoin = 0`: The outer edges of the strokes for the two segments are extended until they meet at an angle, as in a picture frame. If the segments meet at too sharp an angle, a bevel join is used instead.
- `RoundJoin = 1`: An arc of a circle with a diameter equal to the line width is drawn around the point where the two segments meet, connecting the outer edges of the strokes for the two segments. This pieslice-shaped figure is filled in, producing a rounded corner.
- `BevelJoin = 2`: The two segments are finished with butt caps and the resulting notch beyond the ends of the segments is filled with a triangle.

---

# LogOutputFlags Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/LogOutputFlags

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Flags that control where DLE log output is written.

Multiple flags can be combined using bitwise OR to send log output to more than one destination simultaneously.

## Values

- `None = 0`: Disable all logging
- `Console = 0x0002`: Use Console to write log
- `File = 0x0004`: Use file to write log.
- `EventLog = 0x0008`: Post log in Windows Logs -> Application

```csharp
class LogParams : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Defines the parameters for writing error messages to a log file.

The messages include the date and time, the source of the error, and the error type: debug, info, warning, error, or fatal. This class also defines the log file name and path.

**Referenced by:** [`Library`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Library.md)

**Uses types:** [`LogOutputFlags`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/LogOutputFlags.md)

## Properties


### LogFormat

```csharp
string Datalogics.PDFL.LogParams.LogFormat { get; set; }
```

Gets log format string. The string which allows to write the log in a custom format.

NOTE: PDFL supports the following markers to form output string:

"%d" - current date (mmddyyyy). Example: 07292013 "%t" - current time (hhmmss). Example: 121311 "%s" - error source. Example: "DLFramework" "%e" - error type. It can be debug, info, warning, error, fatal. The value which will be output within this marker depends on severity value. It always outputs "error" string.

"%m" - error message. Example: "Exception: InExistent.pdf: This file cannot be found. Error number: 1074397201" "%T" - full date. It contains current date, current time and the timezone (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss+/-hh:mm). Example: 2013-07-29T12:13:11+03:00

By default "%T | %s | %e | %m" string format is used.

### LogOutputFlags

```csharp
LogOutputFlags Datalogics.PDFL.LogParams.LogOutputFlags { get; set; }
```

Gets LogOutputFlags.

Supported types of logging are: console, file and Event Log (for Windows only). The outputs can be mixed by ORing corresponding flags. It is also possible to suppress any logging using LogOutputFlags.None.

# Matrix Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Matrix

```csharp
class Matrix : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

A transformation matrix in a PDF file is specified by six numbers.

The matrix is usually in the form of an array containing the six elements [a b c d h v].

A translation is specified as [ 1 0 0 1 tx ty], where tx and ty are the distance to translate from the origin of the coordinate system in the horizontal and vertical dimension, respectively.

A scaling is obtained by [sx 0 0 sy 0 0]. This scales the coordinates so that 1 unit in the horizontal and vertical dimension of the new coordinate system is the same size as sx and sy units, respectively, as in the previous coordinate system.

A rotation is produced by [ cos T sin T -sin T cos T 0 0 ], which has the effect of rotating the coordinate system axes by an angle T (degrees) counterclockwise.

This material indicates that the matrix specifying a transformation is premultiplied with the current transformation matrix, i.e.,

M' = Mt * M

The implementation of the Scale, Rotate, and Translate convenience functions of Matrix reflect the same order of operations, so that they are consistent with the PDF Reference manual. They are also consistent with the scale, rotate, and translate operators in PostScript, from which the coordinate system model in PDF is derived.

**Referenced by:** [`Container`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Container.md), [`Content`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Content.md), [`DrawParams`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/DrawParams.md), [`Element`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Element.md), [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md), [`Group`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Group.md), [`Image`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image.md), [`Matrix`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Matrix.md), [`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md), [`Path`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Path.md), [`Point`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Point.md), [`PostScript`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PostScript.md), [`Quad`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Quad.md), [`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md), [`Shading`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Shading.md), [`Text`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Text.md), [`TextRun`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/TextRun.md)

**Uses types:** [`Matrix`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Matrix.md)

## Description

The behavior to use if a suitable Font can't be found to represent the recognized Text.

## Values

- `RaiseAnException = 0`: Raise an exception.
- `IgnoreMissingFont = 1`: Ignore the missing Font and continue recognizing the next Word of Text.

# MoveTo Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/MoveTo

```csharp
class MoveTo : Segment
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Segment`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Segment.md)

## Description

An operator that creates a path by moving to a new current position.

A LineTo operator creates an addition to a path element by moving to the (x,y) coordinates specified in the MoveTo statement. The MoveTo coordinates serve as the new current position, and from here a new path element can start.

For example, the MoveTo coordinates can define the starting position for a LineTo operator. The LineTo operator draws a straight line from the current position (MoveTo) to a new position, the set of (x,y) coordinates defined with the LineTo operator: MoveTo{x:0 y:50} LineTo{x:100 y:100}

**Uses types:** [`Point`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Point.md)

## Constructors

### MoveTo

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.MoveTo.MoveTo(double x, double y)
```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `x` (`double`): The horizontal coordinate of the new current point.
- `y` (`double`): The vertical coordinate of the new current point.

Move to a new current point specified by coordinates.

Begin a new subpath by moving the current point to coordinates x, y, omitting any connecting line segment. If the previous path segment in the current path was also a MoveTo, the new m overrides it; no vestige of the previous MoveTo operation remains in the path.

### MoveTo

```csharp

```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `newCurrentPoint` ([`Point`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Point.md)): The new current point to move to.

Move to a new current point.

Begin a new subpath by moving the current point to a new point, omitting any connecting line segment. If the previous path segment in the current path was also a MoveTo, the new m overrides it; no vestige of the previous MoveTo operation remains in the path.

# NameTree Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/NameTree

```csharp
class NameTree : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

The name tree is a common data structure in PDF files.

A name tree is a type of dictionary that can store many more pairs of matched records than a standard object dictionary.

A name tree uses keys that are character strings to map to data objects. The strings can use a standard coding format, such as Unicode, are sorted in order in the data structure, and can be associated with any type of object.

**Referenced by:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md), [`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md), [`PDFString`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFString.md)

# NumberStyle Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/NumberStyle

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Specifies the numbering style for page labels in a document.

## Values

- `Decimal = 0`: Decimal arabic numerals (1,2,3...)
- `RomanUppercase = 1`: Uppercase Roman numerals (I,II,III...)
- `RomanLowercase = 2`: Lowercase Roman numerals (i,ii,iii...)
- `LetterUppercase = 3`: Uppercase letters (A,B,C...AA,BB...)
- `LetterLowercase = 4`: Lowercase letters (a,b,c...aa,bb...)
- `None = 5`: Use no NumberStyle, only Prefix

# OCREngine Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OCREngine

```csharp
class OCREngine : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Represents an OCR Engine and its configuration.

Create an OCREngine object once, and reuse it to convert multiple images to Form objects to avoid repeating the sometimes expensive initialization of the engine. The configuration of the engine can't be changed after it's created; if you need to do that, create another OCREngine object.

**Referenced by:** [`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md)


**Returns:** [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md)

a Form element containing the image with text underneath.

Recognize text in the image, returning a form element with the image and the text underneath.

Run the image through an OCR engine. Creates a Form element containing the image, and additional text underneath. The Form element has a transformation matrix which makes it directly substitutable for the image in a Content stream.

This method may throw an exception if it can't find a font that will represent all the characters in a word. See the candidateFontNames on OCRParams to supply more fonts.

### PlaceTextUnder

```csharp
Form Datalogics.PDFL.OCREngine.PlaceTextUnder(Image image, Document inDocument)
```

**Parameters**

- `image` ([`Image`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image.md)): The image in which to recognize text.
- `inDocument` ([`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)): The destination document for the created form.

**Returns:** [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md)

a Form element containing the image with text underneath.

Recognize text in the image, returning a form element with the image and the text underneath.

Run the image through an OCR engine. Creates a Form element containing the image, and additional text underneath. The Form element has a transformation matrix which makes it directly substitutable for the image in a Content stream.

The form will be created in the specified document, sharing fonts with the results of recognizing text in other images.

This method may throw an exception if it can't find a font that will represent all the characters in a word. See the candidateFontNames on OCRParams to supply more fonts.

**Parameters**

- `image` ([`Image`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image.md)): The image in which to recognize text.
- `inDocument` ([`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)): The destination document for the created form.
- `resolution` (`double`): The resolution of the Image being recognized.

**Returns:** [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md)

a Form element containing the image with text underneath.

Recognize text in the image of the known resolution, returning a form element with the image and the text underneath. Knowing the image's resolution can enhance recognition.

NOTE: Determining the resolution of the image is the caller's responsibility.

Run the image through an OCR engine. Creates a Form element containing the image, and additional text underneath. The Form element has a transformation matrix which makes it directly substitutable for the image in a Content stream.

The form will be created in the specified document, sharing fonts with the results of recognizing text in other images.

If a font that will represent all the characters in a word can't be found, an exception will be raised.

# OCRParams Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OCRParams

```csharp
class OCRParams : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Parameters for configuring the OCR (Optical Character Recognition) engine.

OCRParams controls settings such as the engine to use, the resolution of the input images, the language(s) to recognize, performance tuning, page segmentation mode, candidate font names for placing text, and image preprocessing options.

**Referenced by:** [`OCREngine`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OCREngine.md)

**Uses types:** [`LanguageSetting`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LanguageSetting.md), [`PageSegmentationMode`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PageSegmentationMode.md), [`Performance`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/Performance.md)

## Constructors

### OCRParams

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.OCRParams.OCRParams()
```

*constructor*

Create an OCRParams structure with defaults.

## Properties

### CandidateFontNames

```csharp
System.Collections.Generic.IList<System.String> Datalogics.PDFL.OCRParams.CandidateFontNames { get; set; }
```

The names of candidate fonts for placing text under an image.

The default list should work well in most cases. If you're using text that isn't represented by Latin fonts, or by Chinese, Japanese, or Korean fonts, then retrieve this list, add the font that can represent that text, then set that new list on this object.

Enough font names must be supplied to cover the expected languages/scripts in use.

The code selects a font to represent each word. If a word code-switches between different scripts, for instance, if it contains non-Latin text and Arabic numerals, then make sure to supply the name of a font family that can handle both the text and the numerals.

The quality of the results depends on the font choice. The list is searched in order until a font works for a particular word. To make the text fit better, it's recommended to list proportional fonts before fixed-width fonts. Decorative fonts with flourishes, like Zapf Chancery, deliver poor results. Generally, supply a font that would be used in block text, such as in a newspaper or work of literature, such as Times Roman, or a font already in the list, like MinionPro.

If the PlaceTextUnder method in OCREngine can't identify a font that covers the whole text of a word, an exception will be thrown.

# OptimizerOption Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/OptimizerOption

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Select the optimization option to be set or obtained.

## Values

- `DownsampleColor = 1`: When this option is ON, Downsample all color images above MAX DPI to ResetTo DPI. Default is ON.
- `RecompressColor = 2`: When this option is ON, recompress all color images which are compressed by a different scheme than one select by RecompressTo to RecompressTo. Default is ON.
- `DownsampleGray = 3`: When this option is ON, Downsample all gray scale images above MAX DPI to ResetTo DPI. Default is ON.
- `RecompressGray = 4`: When this option is ON, recompress all gray scale images which are compressed by a different scheme than one select by RecompressTo to RecompressTo. Default is ON.
- `DownsampleBW = 5`: When this option is ON, Downsample all Black and White images above MAX DPI to ResetTo DPI. Default is ON.
- `RecompressBW = 6`: When this option is ON, recompress all Black and White images which are compressed by a different scheme than one select by RecompressTo to RecompressTo. Default is ON.
- `RecompressOnlyIfSmaller = 7`: In all of the above Downsample and Recompress operations, if this option is ON, replace the image ONLY if the resultant compressed image is smaller than the original. Default is ON.
- `DiscardAlternateImages = 8`: When this option is ON, any Alternate Images defined for a given image (Images in different resolutions than the base image) will be discarded. Default is ON.
- `SubsetAllEmbeddedFonts = 9`: When this option is ON, any fonts which are embedded, but not subset, will be replaced with subset fonts. This can save considerable space in a document, but does so at the risk of preventing future edits to the document. Default is ON.
- `ReSubsetAllSubsetFonts = 37`: When this option is ON, any fonts which are subset embedded, will be replaced with a newly subset font. This will generally only happen if the document has been edited since it was created, or the document contains only a subset of the page that it originally contained. NOTE: This can only REMOVE glyphs from the subset font. It cannot add glyphs that were not present int he original subset. Default is ON.
- `RemoveAllEmbeddedFonts = 10`: When this option is ON, all embedded fonts will be removed. If this is done, the document can only be viewed on platforms which contain all of the fonts required. Generally, you would want to do this only in very tightly controlled circumstances. Default is OFF.
- `RemoveAllBase14Fonts = 11`: This will remove any embedded base 14 fonts. Generally, it is safe to remove these fonts, as any platform that supports PDF should have locally available copies of them. However, there is still some risk that the embedded fonts are not identical to the actual base14 fonts, and hence may render differently. Default is OFF.
- `MergeDuplicateFonts = 12`: When this option is ON, the document will be searched for mutliple copies of the same font. These will then be combined into a single font. Default is ON.
- `DiscardBookmarks = 13`: When this option is ON, all bookmarks will be removed from the document. Note that this information cannot be reconstructed. Default is OFF.
- `DiscardAcroforms = 14`: When this option is ON, All acroform structures will be removed from the document. NOTE: Filled in fields, if any, will be left in the document. So the content of those fields will continue to display. Default is ON.
- `DiscardOutputIntent = 15`: When this option is ON, any OutputIntent structures in the document, along with their associated color profiles, will be removed. This may cause color shifting, when rendering the document. Default is OFF.
- `DiscardThumbnails = 16`: When this option is ON, any thumbnails embedded in the document will be removed. Default is ON.
- `DiscardPageLabels = 17`: When this option is ON, discard any Page Label Trees embedded in the document This may cause a difference in the display and selection of pages in some viewers. Default is ON.
- `DiscardNameTress = 18`: When this option is ON, discard any NameTrees in the document. This may cause issues with links within the document. Default is ON.
- `DiscardStructureTrees = 19`: When this option is ON, discard any structure trees in the document. Default is OFF.
- `DiscardFileAttachments = 20`: When this option is ON, remove any document embedded in the PDF Document. Default is ON.
- `DiscardXMPPadding = 21`: When this option is ON, remove from the XMP Metadata any padding areas, left to allow the XMP data to be updated. Default is ON.
- `DiscardUnusedForms = 22`: When this option is ON, remove any Forms XObjects which are included in the document, but never displayed in the document. Default is ON.
- `DiscardPieceData = 23`: When this option is ON, remove any user supplied private PieceData embedded in the document. This will never effect appearance, but may limit the use of special processing by the application that provided this data. Default is ON.
- `CompressStreams = 24`: When this option is ON, any streams (of more than 20 bytes length) which are not compressed will be compressed using Flate. Default is ON.
- `ReplaceLZW = 25`: When this option is ON, any LZW Compressed streams will be recompressed using Flate. Default is ON.
- `DiscardMetadata = 26`: When this option is ON, any Metadata embedded in the document (Except for the document level Metadata) will be removed. Default is OFF.
- `DiscardDocumentInfo = 27`: When this option is ON, any Document Information, beyond the basic information supplied by APDFL, will be discarded. Note that this will also remove that information from the document level Metadata. Default is OFF.
- `OptimizeContentStreams = 28`: When this option is ON, attempt to find common segments of code at the start of page content, and share a single copy of such common code. Default is ON.
- `Linearize = 29`: When this option is ON, create the optimized document as Linearized (Optimized for Web Access). Default is OFF.
- `DiscardDuplicateForms = 30`: When this option is ON, locate and remove duplicate copies of forms, using a single copy for all references to that form. Default is ON.
- `DiscardDuplicateObjects = 31`: When this option is ON, locate and remove duplicate copies of objects, using a single copy for all references to that object. Default is ON.
- `DiscardASCIIFilters = 32`: When this option is ON, remove the ASCIIHex and ASCII85 filters from any streams that use these as their final filters. These have historically been used to render data safe in a 7 bit data channel, or for debugging purposes Default is ON.
- `DiscardComments = 33`: When this option is ON, remove all annotations which are commentary to the content (All "Markup" annotations). Default is OFF.
- `DiscardAnnotations = 34`: When this option is ON, remove all annotations, of all types, from all pages. This may result in visible loss of information in the rendered pages. Default is OFF.
- `DiscardJavaScriptActions = 35`: When this option is ON, remove all JavaScript actions in the document. Default is OFF.
- `FlattenOptionalContent = 36`: When this option is ON, Optional Content in the document is Flattened. Default is OFF.
- `DownConvert16To8BpcImages = 38`: When this option is ON, down-converts all 16 Bits Per Component images to 8 Bits Per Component. Default is ON.
- `DiscardUnusedImages = 39`: When this option is ON, remove any Image XObjects which are included in the document, but never displayed in the document. Default is ON.
- `DiscardUnusedFonts = 40`: When this option is ON, remove any Fonts which are included in the document, but never used in the document. Default is ON.

# OptionalContentConfig Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentConfig

```csharp
class OptionalContentConfig : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

A structure used to store data related to layers in a PDF.

The Optional Content Configuration Structure is used to maintain a set of visibility states and other optional values related to layers, or Optional Content Groups, within a PDF file.

These configuration values are stored for future use.

The default configuration for a PDF document is stored in the D entry in the Optional Content Properties dictionary.

An Optional Content Group, or layer, is a set of graphic images that can be made visible or invisible within a PDF file, and the Optional Content Configuration Structure is typically used to set the initial value for these images-On or Off, visible or invisible.

**Referenced by:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`OptionalContentBaseState`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/OptionalContentBaseState.md), [`OptionalContentGroup`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentGroup.md), [`OptionalContentOrderArray`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentOrderArray.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md)

## Properties

### BaseState

```csharp
OptionalContentBaseState Datalogics.PDFL.OptionalContentConfig.BaseState { get; set; }
```

Get the base state for this OptionalContentConfig. When this config is applied to an OptionalContentContext, all OptionalContentGroups will be set to according to this base state:

• If BaseState is set to BaseStateOff, when this OptionalContentConfig is applied to an OptionalContentContext:

• All OptionalContentGroups in the document are set to OFF, and

• Any OptionalContentGroups in this OptionalContentConfig's ON array are then set to on.

• If BaseState is set to BaseStateOn, when this OptionalContentConfig is applied to an OptionalContentContext:

• All OptionalContentGroups in the document are set to ON, and

• Any OptionalContentGroups in this OptionalContentConfig's OFF array are then set to off.

• If BaseState is set to BaseStateUnchanged, when this OptionalContentConfig is applied to an OptionalContentContext:

• Any OptionalContentGroups in this OptionalContentConfig's ON array are set to on

• Any OptionalContentGroups in this OptionalContentConfig's OFF array are set to off

• Any OptionalContentGroups in neither the ON or OFF array are unaffected

## Description

Defines the context for optional content in a PDF.

An Optional Content Context is a status object that defines the context for optional content within a document.

The context tracks the On/Off status for Optional Content Groups (layers) within a document. It contains flags that control whether to display content that is marked as optional.

# OptionalContentDrawingPolicy Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/OptionalContentDrawingPolicy

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

The policy for drawing optional content within the document.

## Values

- `VisibleOptionalContent = 0`: Draw optional content that is visible according to the current state of the OptionalContentGroups and OptionalContentMembershipDicts.
- `AllOptionalContent = 1`: Draw all optional content, regardless of visibility state.
- `NoOptionalContent = 2`: Do not draw any optional content, regardless of visibility state.

```csharp
class OptionalContentGroup : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

A dictionary used to manage graphics images in a PDF.

An Optional Content Group is a dictionary that represents a set of graphics images that users can turn on or off in a PDF document, making them visible or invisible.

In a PDF Viewer, Optional Content Groups are referred to as "Layers."

# OptionalContentMembershipDict Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentMembershipDict

```csharp
class OptionalContentMembershipDict : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Attaches content to one or more optional content groups.

Form, container, and annotation objects can be associated with one or more optional content groups. By associating them with an optional content group, they become part of that 'layer', and the user can control the visibility of the content.

Note that by placing other element objects in a container, they can also be associated with an optional content group.

An OptionalContentMembershipDict connects content to the OptionalContentGroup; it contains a list of OptionalContentGroups, and rules for determining visibility when the OptionalContentGroups have conflicting on/off states in the active OptionalContentContext.

An OptionalContentMembershipDict cannot be changed once created; you must create a new OptionalContentMembershipDict and change the objects to point to it.

**Referenced by:** [`Annotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Annotation.md), [`CircleAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/CircleAnnotation.md), [`Container`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Container.md), [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md), [`FreeTextAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/FreeTextAnnotation.md), [`HighlightAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/HighlightAnnotation.md), [`InkAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/InkAnnotation.md), [`LineAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LineAnnotation.md), [`LinkAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LinkAnnotation.md), [`PolyLineAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PolyLineAnnotation.md), [`PolygonAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PolygonAnnotation.md), [`Redaction`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Redaction.md), [`SquareAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/SquareAnnotation.md), [`TextMarkupAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/TextMarkupAnnotation.md), [`UnderlineAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/UnderlineAnnotation.md)

# OptionalContentOrderArray Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentOrderArray

```csharp
class OptionalContentOrderArray : OptionalContentOrderNode
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`OptionalContentOrderNode`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentOrderNode.md)

## Description

Array node class for items in the OptionalContentConfig Order array.

Items in the Order array can be arranged into a tree structure; subarrays within the parent array form 'branches' of the tree. Each OptionalContentOrderArray may contain OptionalContentOrderLeafs or OptionalContentOrderArrays in a specific order; this order determines how they will appear in the 'Layers' control of the viewer.

By placing OptionalContentOrderArrays into a higher-level array, branches can be added to the tree. The 'Title' property is a string that will appear next to the expand/collapse branch control in a PDF Viewer 'Layers' panel.

**Referenced by:** [`OptionalContentConfig`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentConfig.md)

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`OptionalContentOrderNode`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentOrderNode.md)

Creates and acquires a new page. The page is inserted into the document at the specified location. Call PDPageRelease() when you are done using the page.
