## Properties

### ArtBox

```csharp
Rect Datalogics.PDFL.Page.ArtBox { get; set; }
```

Get the page's ArtBox.

The ArtBox defines the extent of the page's meaningful content (including potential white space) as intended by the page's creator.

### BBox

```csharp
Rect Datalogics.PDFL.Page.BBox { get; }
```

Get the page's Bounding Box.

The BBox is the smallest rectangle that encloses all of the page's visible content. Unlike the other page boxes, it is calculated from the page content and cannot be set directly.

### BleedBox

```csharp
Rect Datalogics.PDFL.Page.BleedBox { get; set; }
```

Get the page's BleedBox.

The BleedBox defines the region to which the contents of the page shall be clipped when output in a production environment. It includes any extra bleed area needed to account for limitations of cutting, folding, and trimming equipment.

### Content

```csharp
Content Datalogics.PDFL.Page.Content { get; }
```

Creates a Content from the Page object's contents and resources.

Calls to GetContent without an intervening UpdateContent return the same cached Content object, so edits made through earlier handles are visible. After a call to UpdateContent, a subsequent GetContent returns a fresh Content that reflects the committed state.

### CropBox

```csharp
Rect Datalogics.PDFL.Page.CropBox { get; set; }
```

Get the page's CropBox.

The CropBox defines the region to which the contents of the page are to be clipped (cropped) when displayed or printed. The default value is the page's MediaBox.

### MediaBox

```csharp
Rect Datalogics.PDFL.Page.MediaBox { get; set; }
```

Get the page's MediaBox.

The MediaBox defines the boundaries of the physical medium on which the page is intended to be displayed or printed. It is the largest of the page boxes and serves as the default for the CropBox.

### NumAnnotations

```csharp
int Datalogics.PDFL.Page.NumAnnotations { get; }
```

Gets the number of annotations on a page. Annotations associated with pop-up windows (such as strikeouts) are counted as two annotations. Widget annotations (form fields) are included in the count.

### PDFDict

```csharp
PDFDict Datalogics.PDFL.Page.PDFDict { get; }
```

Retrieve the PDFObject representation of this object.

### PageNumber

```csharp
int Datalogics.PDFL.Page.PageNumber { get; }
```

Retrieve the page number for this PDF page.

Page numbers always start at zero.

### RenderWarnings

```csharp
int Datalogics.PDFL.Page.RenderWarnings { get; }
```

Reports possible page rendering problems.

### Rotation

```csharp
PageRotation Datalogics.PDFL.Page.Rotation { get; set; }
```

The number of degrees by which the page is rotated clockwise when displayed or printed.

### TrimBox

```csharp
Rect Datalogics.PDFL.Page.TrimBox { get; set; }
```

Get the page's TrimBox.

The TrimBox defines the intended dimensions of the finished page after trimming. It may be smaller than the MediaBox to account for production- related content such as printing instructions or cut marks.

### UserUnit

```csharp
float Datalogics.PDFL.Page.UserUnit { get; set; }
```

Gets the size of default user space units for the page.

### DrawContents

```csharp
System.Byte[] Datalogics.PDFL.Page.DrawContents(DrawParams drawParams)
```

**Parameters**

- `drawParams` ([`DrawParams`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/DrawParams.md)): Parameters for the drawing operation

**Returns:** `System.Byte[]`

an array of bytes containing the image.

Draw the contents of the page into a bitmap, and return the raw bitmap data as an array of bytes arranged in left to right, top to bottom order. Each row of the bitmap is aligned onto a four-byte boundary.

The amount of data returned depends on the destRect parameter. Using integer arithmetic:

stride = (width * components + 3) & ~3

array_size = stride * height

### FlattenOptionalContent

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.Page.FlattenOptionalContent()
```

**Returns:** `bool`

true if the page was successfully flattened, false otherwise.

Flattens optional content on the page.

This page will be replaced with a version that has no optional content. The new version of the page will contain only what was visible on the page when the call was made.

The document's default optional content context will be used to determine visibility of optional content.

The optional content information formerly associated with content on the page will NOT be deleted from the document, as it is possible for optional content groups to contain items on multiple pages.

**Returns:** `bool`

true if the page was successfully flattened, false otherwise.

Flattens optional content on the page.

This page will be replaced with a version that has no optional content. The new version of the page will contain only what was visible on the page when the call was made.

### GetBitmap

```csharp
System.Drawing.Bitmap Datalogics.PDFL.Page.GetBitmap(Rect exportRect, PageImageParams pip)
```

**Parameters**

- `exportRect` ([`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md)): A Rect describing the region of the page to export, specified in user space coordinates. One user unit corresponds to 1/72 inch.

  To export the entire page, set this parameter to the page's CropBox.

  User space coordinates correspond to the **unrotated** page; the rotation specified in Page.Rotation is not taken into account with these coordinates.
- `pip` ([`PageImageParams`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PageImageParams.md)): Additional parameters for the exported image, including the exported image's pixel width, pixel height, and resolution. If these parameters are not specified, the pixel width and height of the returned image are calculated using the exportRect and a resolution of 300.0.

**Returns:** `System.Drawing.Bitmap`

Export a region of a PDF page to a System.Drawing.Bitmap.

A particular size in pixels can be specified for the exported Bitmap by setting ImageParams.PixelWidth and/or ImageParams.PixelHeight.

If the exportRect is smaller than the PDF page and pip.PixelWidth and pip.PixelHeight are set, then the resulting image will be of the size pip.PixelWidth x pip.PixelHeight and contain the area of the page inside the exportRect, scaled to fit.

It is also possible to use this function by specifying only pip.PixelWidth or only pip.PixelHeight. When only one is specified, the function will calculate the other.

User space coordinates correspond to the unrotated page; the rotation specified in Page.Rotation is not taken into account with these coordinates.
- `ImageParams` ([`PageImageParams`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PageImageParams.md)): A PageImageParams containing additional parameters for the exported image, including the exported image's pixel width, pixel height, and resolution. If these parameters are not specified, the pixel width and pixel height of the image are calculated using the exportRect and a resolution of 300.0.
- `spacesCollection` ([`System.Collections.Generic.IList< SeparationColorSpace >`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/SeparationColorSpace.md)): A collection of SeparationColorSpace class additional parameter for specifying colorants for bitmap rendering. Each SeparationColorSpace must be constructed from an ink and a page. Their tint transforms and alternates will be ignored.

**Returns:** [`ImageCollection`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ImageCollection.md)

An ImageCollection containing one Image per separation colorant.

Export a region of a PDF page using the specified Separation ColorSpaces to an Image Collection object.

This version of GetImage can be used to specify a particular size in pixels for the exported image by setting ImageParams.PixelWidth and/or ImageParams.PixelHeight.

If the exportRect is smaller than the PDF page and ImageParams.PixelWidth and ImageParams.PixelHeight are set, then the resulting image will be of the size ImageParams.PixelWidth x ImageParams.PixelHeight and contain the area of the page inside the exportRect, scaled to fit.

It is also possible to use this function by specifying only ImageParams.PixelWidth or only ImageParams.PixelHeight. When only one is specified, the function will calculate the other.

### RemoveAnnotation

```csharp
void Datalogics.PDFL.Page.RemoveAnnotation(int annotIndex)
```

**Parameters**

- `annotIndex` (`int`): The index (into the page's annotation array) of the annotation to remove.

**Returns:** `void`

Removes an annotation from the specified page. Annotations are stored in arrays, which are automatically compressed when an annotation is removed. For this reason, if you use a loop in which you remove annotations, structure the code so the loop processes from the highest to the lowest index. If you loop the other direction, you will skip over annotations immediately following ones you remove.

**Exceptions**

- `pdErrOpNotPermitted`: is raised if:

  • The annotation is of subtype Text and the document's permissions do not include EditNotes (see PermissionFlags).

  • The annotation is of any other subtype and the document's permissions do not include Edit.

### UpdateContent

```csharp
void Datalogics.PDFL.Page.UpdateContent()
```

**Returns:** `void`

Commits in-memory edits to the Page's Content back into the Page, using the same compression filters the content was previously encoded with.

Edits made through the Content object returned by GetContent are held in memory until UpdateContent is called. Document.Save does not implicitly commit content edits; a Page that has been edited but not committed will be saved in its pre-edit state.

## Description

Used to manage converting a PDF page to an image.

The Page Image Parameters are a set of parameters used to control converting a PDF page to an image, such as a PNG, JPG, or BMP. The parameters include pixel height & width, color space, resolution, so on.

**Referenced by:** [`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md)

# PageInsertFlags Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PageInsertFlags

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Values

- `None = 0`: Do not insert bookmarks, threads, or document data.
- `Bookmarks = 1`: Insert bookmarks as well as pages.
- `All = 4096`: Insert all Catalog and Info dictionary values as well as pages. The bookmark tree of the inserted document is merged into the bookmark tree of the target document by copying it as a new first-level subtree of that document's bookmark tree root, of which it becomes the last child. If the target document has no bookmark tree, it acquires one identical to the bookmark tree from the source document.
- `Threads = 2`: Insert articles as well.
- `DoNotMergeFonts = 8`: Do not merge duplicate fonts on merge: may result in larger files when saved, but can show performance benefits when inserting a page that uses a large number of fonts
- `DoNotResolveInvalidStructureParentReferences = 16`: Do not resolve invalid Parent References in the Structure Tree. This is not necessary in most cases and can show performance benefits for a document with a complicated Structure Tree.
- `DoNotRemovePageInheritance = 32`: Do not remove page inheritance. This can slow down the performance when document has very large page tree.

# PageLabel Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PageLabel

```csharp
class PageLabel : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Describes numbering labels for a range of pages.

PageLabel describes how to construct a label string for a range of pages. It contains information on number style, any prefixes, and a starting position within the document.

Note that a single PageLabel describes the label string for several pages all pages up until the first page covered by the next PageLabel, or the end of the document.

Also note that if a Document has any PageLabels, there must be one that starts at page index 0. This will be automatically created if the user does not supply one.

**Referenced by:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)

**Uses types:** [`NumberStyle`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/NumberStyle.md)

# PageMarkFlags Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PageMarkFlags

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Bit flags indicating which page marks are emitted for color separations.

## Values

- `ColorBars = 1`: Emit color bar marks for verifying color reproduction.
- `RegistrationMarks = 2`: Emit registration marks for aligning color separations.
- `CropMarks = 4`: Emit crop marks indicating where the page should be trimmed.
- `BleedMarks = 8`: Emit bleed marks indicating the bleed area boundary.
- `PageInfo = 16`: Emit page information such as the file name and date.
- `TrimMarks = 32`: Emit trim marks indicating the finished page dimensions.
- `SlurMarks = 64`: Emit slur marks for detecting imaging distortion.

# PageMode Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PageMode

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

An enumerated data type used to describe the page view mode of a Document.

## Values

- `NoPreference = 0`: Leave the PageMode as is (default for a new Document)
- `DocumentOnly = 1`: Display the Document without Bookmarks or Thumbnails (appears in the Document structure as "UseNone")
- `Bookmarks = 3`: Display the Document with the Bookmarks panel open (appears in the Document structure as "UseOutlines")
- `Thumbnails = 2`: Display the Document with the Thumbnails panel open
- `Fullscreen = 4`: Display the Document in full-screen mode
- `OptionalContent = 6`: Display the Document with the Layers panel open
- `Attachments = 7`: Display the Document with its attachments

## Values

- `NeedAppearancesFlagWarning = 0x01`: The NeedAppearances flag is on in the AcroForm dictionary and some content may not render
- `AnnotRTSWarning = 0x02`: One or more Annotations contain Rich Text String Content and will not render if the NormalAppearance stream is not set
- `AnnotMissingNormalAppearanceWarning = 0x04`: One or more Annotations of an unsupported type are missing its NormalAppearance stream and will not render
- `LessImageDataThanExpectedWarning = 0x08`: An image on the page lacks sufficient data, if rendered the missing data will be filled in by white pixels.

# Path Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Path

```csharp
class Path : Element
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Element`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Element.md)

## Description

A path in a PDF file defines shapes.

Paths in PDF files are used to draw lines, define filled areas, and define boundaries for clipping graphics. A path is composed of straight and curved line segments.

**Referenced by:** [`Path`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Path.md)

# PathOperators Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PathOperators

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Enumerated data type for path segment operators in PDEPath elements.

Each value corresponds to a PDF path construction operator (moveto, lineto, curveto, etc.).

## Values

- `Move = 0`: Designates the m (moveto) operator, which moves the current point.
- `Line = 1`: Designates the l (lineto) operator, which appends a straight line segment from the current point.
- `Curve = 2`: Designates the c (curveto) operator, which appends a bezier curve to the path.
- `RectPath = 3`: Designates the re operator, which adds a rectangle to the current path.
- `Close = 4`: Designates the h (closepath) operator, which closes the current sub-path.

---

# PathPaintOpFlags Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PathPaintOpFlags

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Flags indicating the different paint operations for a Path.

These flags control whether a path is stroked, filled, or both, and which fill rule is used.

## Values

- `Neither = 0x00`: The path is neither stroked or filled.
- `Stroke = 0x01`: Stroke the path, as with the S (stroke) operator.
- `Fill = 0x02`: Fill the path, using the nonzero winding rule to determine the region to fill, as with the f (fill) operator.
- `EoFill = 0x04`: Fill the path, using the even/odd rule to determine the region to fill, as with the f* (eofill) operator.

---

# PDFAConvertParams Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFAConvertParams

```csharp
class PDFAConvertParams : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Parameters for converting a document to PDF/A compliance.

These parameters control how a Document is converted to the PDF/A standard.

• `RemoveAllAnnotations` if true, will remove all Annotations and Actions from the output

• `IgnoreFontErrors` if true, will try to rasterize the page when fonts cannot be embedded

• `AbortIfXFAIsPresent` if true, will abort conversion process if XFA form entry is detected

• `NoValidationErrors` if true, will ignore validation errors

• `RasterizationResolution` rasterization resolution; if 0, use 72 DPI

• `ValidateImplementationLimitsOfDocument` Validate PDF Implementation Limits of the Document.

PDF/A is an ISO-standard version the PDF format. It is designed to be used with PDF files that need to be archived and stored for long periods. For example, the fonts in a PDF/A file are embedded in the file itself, rather than accessed through a link to a font directory on a local server.

**Referenced by:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)

## Constructors

### PDFAConvertParams


## Properties

### AbortIfXFAIsPresent

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFAConvertParams.AbortIfXFAIsPresent { get; set; }
```

The presence of XFA can result in some loss of data in output PDF/A-1 file as the PDFProcessor does not support XFA. However you can choose to abort the conversion if XFA is present by setting this parameter to true. By default we will not abort if XFA is present for PDF/A-1.

By default we will not abort if XFA is present for PDF/A-1.

If false we will convert even if XFA is found. If true we will abort the process if XFA is found.

### IgnoreFontErrors

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFAConvertParams.IgnoreFontErrors { get; set; }
```

If we encounter any errors like unembeddable fonts etc. while conversion then we try to rasterize the current page on which the error occured. However the client can modify this behavior by setting the value of this parameter to false in which case we will throw an error if we encounter any problems while conversion.

By default we will rasterize the page on error.

If true we will try to rasterize the current page if any error occured. If false we will abort and throw an exception if any error occured.

### NoValidationErrors

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFAConvertParams.NoValidationErrors { get; set; }
```

Permit validation errors to be ignored

When true, PDF Implementation Limits (as defined in the PDF Specification of the PDF/A target) of the page are ignored. When false, PDF Implementation Limits of the Page are checked and if violated will cause the Page to be rasterized as a fallback mechanism when IgnoreFontErrors is true or simply raise an error if IgnoreFontErrors is false.

### ProfileDesc

```csharp
string Datalogics.PDFL.PDFAConvertParams.ProfileDesc { get; set; }
```

The Output Intent of a PDF/A document may be any valid CMYK Profile for CMYK Conversion, and any valid RGB profile for RGB conversion. This parameter allows the user to specify a particular profile for this conversion by description. When this parameter is not present, the profile "U.S. Web Coated (SWOP) v2" will be used for CMYK Conversions, and "sRGB IEC61966-2.1" for RGB conversions.

If this description is present, and specifies a profile of the wrong color family, or specifies a profile which cannot be located in resources, an exception will be raised.

### RasterizationResolution

```csharp
ushort Datalogics.PDFL.PDFAConvertParams.RasterizationResolution { get; set; }
```

Permit user to select rasterization resolution When this value is zero, we will rasterize at 72 DPI (Legacy Behaviour). Otherwise, we will interpret the value as the desired resolution.

### RemoveAllAnnotations

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFAConvertParams.RemoveAllAnnotations { get; set; }
```

Some of the standards like PDF/A prohibit the presence of some types of Annotations and Actions in order to comply with those standards.

By default we will filter all illegal Annotations and Actions.

If false we will filter out all illegal Annotations and Actions (according to the standard being used) while retaining the legal ones. If true this will remove all the Annotations and Actions from the output PDF/A compliant file.

### ValidateImplementationLimitsOfDocument

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFAConvertParams.ValidateImplementationLimitsOfDocument { get; set; }
```

Validate PDF Implementation Limits (as defined in the PDF Specification of the PDF/A target) of the Document. When true. PDF Implementation Limits are checked and if violated raise an error. When false, PDF Implementation Limits are not checked. Note this option applies to the Whole document versus only Pages in the NoValidationErrors option. NOTE: It's recommended NoValidationErrors be set to false, IgnoreFontErrors be set to false, and ValidateImplementationLimitsOfDocument be set to true for getting the best quality output that adheres to the specification.


**Returns:** `void`

## Description

Contains a PDF document if the conversion is successful; returns null if the conversion fails.

PDF/A is an ISO-standard version the PDF format, lighter and designed to be used with PDF files that need to be archived for long periods. For example, the fonts in a PDF/A file are embedded in the file itself, and not accessed from the host machine.

# PDFAConvertType Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFAConvertType

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Specifies the PDF/A conformance level and color space for conversion.

Each value corresponds to a specific PDF/A standard (1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 2u, 3a, 3b, 3u, 4, 4e, 4f) combined with a target color space (RGB or CMYK).

## Values

- `RGB1a = 0`: Convert to PDF/A-1a RGB
- `CMYK1a = 1`: Convert to PDF/A-1a CMYK
- `RGB1b = 2`: Convert to PDF/A-1b RGB
- `CMYK1b = 3`: Convert to PDF/A-1b CMYK
- `RGB2a = 4`: Convert to PDF/A-2a RGB
- `CMYK2a = 5`: Convert to PDF/A-2a CMYK
- `RGB2b = 6`: Convert to PDF/A-2b RGB
- `CMYK2b = 7`: Convert to PDF/A-2b CMYK
- `RGB2u = 8`: Convert to PDF/A-2u RGB
- `CMYK2u = 9`: Convert to PDF/A-2u CMYK
- `RGB3a = 10`: Convert to PDF/A-3a RGB
- `CMYK3a = 11`: Convert to PDF/A-3a CMYK
- `RGB3b = 12`: Convert to PDF/A-3b RGB
- `CMYK3b = 13`: Convert to PDF/A-3b CMYK
- `RGB3u = 14`: Convert to PDF/A-3u RGB
- `CMYK3u = 15`: Convert to PDF/A-3u CMYK
- `RGB4 = 16`: Convert to PDF/A-4 RGB
- `CMYK4 = 17`: Convert to PDF/A-4 CMYK
- `RGB4e = 18`: Convert to PDF/A-4e RGB
- `CMYK4e = 19`: Convert to PDF/A-4e CMYK
- `RGB4f = 20`: Convert to PDF/A-4f RGB
- `CMYK4f = 21`: Convert to PDF/A-4f CMYK

# PDFArray Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFArray

```csharp
class PDFArray : PDFObject
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md)

## Description

Represents an array of data elements within a PDF document.

All objects in a PDF document are built from a collection of simpler objects that represent fundamental datatypes like numbers, strings and arrays. PDFObject and its subclasses allow direct access and manipulation of these simple objects. Some subclasses represent single data elements. For example, PDFInteger represents a single integer value. Others represent a collection of PDFObjects, like PDFArray, an indexed array of data elements.

A PDFArray is a heterogenous collection object that gathers other PDFObjects (including other PDFArrays) into an indexed list.

**Referenced by:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`OptionalContentMembershipDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentMembershipDict.md), [`PDFStream`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFStream.md), [`ViewDestination`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ViewDestination.md)

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md), [`PDFObjectComparison`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFObjectComparison.md), [`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)

### EnumPDFObjects

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFObject.EnumPDFObjects(PDFObjectEnumProc enumProc)
```

**Parameters**

- `enumProc` ([`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)): A user-supplied callback to call for each element of the object. of obj. Neither proc nor any routine called by proc may modify the object. Doing so can produce undefined results or errors. For example, if the object is an array, enumProc must not call Remove(); if the object is a dictionary, enumProc must not call Put().

**Returns:** `bool`

Returns true if every call to enumProc returned true. As soon as any call to enumProc returns false, the enumeration stops and EnumPDFObject() returns false.

Enumerates the elements of a PDFObject by calling a user-supplied procedure for each component of the object.

• For scalars or strings, the proc is not called, and CosObjEnum() returns true.

• For dictionaries, proc is called for each key-value pair. The order in which the key-value pairs are enumerated is undefined.

• For arrays, proc is called with each element as the first paramater to proc, and the NULL object as the second parameter. Array elements are enumerated in ascending order of index.

• For streams, proc is called once, with the stream's dictionary as the first parameter to the proc and the NULL object as the second parameter.

The result is valid only within a single instance of the document.

### Destroy

```csharp
void Datalogics.PDFL.PDFObject.Destroy()
```

**Returns:** `void`

Destroys this object.

This method does nothing if this object is a direct scalar object.

If a composite object (an array, dictionary or stream) is destroyed:

• All the direct objects in it are automatically destroyed.

• The indirect objects in it are not destroyed.

### Dispose

```csharp

```

**Returns:** `void`

### EnumPDFObjects

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFObject.EnumPDFObjects(PDFObjectEnumProc enumProc)
```

**Parameters**

- `enumProc` ([`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)): A user-supplied callback to call for each element of the object. of obj. Neither proc nor any routine called by proc may modify the object. Doing so can produce undefined results or errors. For example, if the object is an array, enumProc must not call Remove(); if the object is a dictionary, enumProc must not call Put().

**Returns:** `bool`

Returns true if every call to enumProc returned true. As soon as any call to enumProc returns false, the enumeration stops and EnumPDFObject() returns false.

Enumerates the elements of a PDFObject by calling a user-supplied procedure for each component of the object.

• For scalars or strings, the proc is not called, and CosObjEnum() returns true.

• For dictionaries, proc is called for each key-value pair. The order in which the key-value pairs are enumerated is undefined.

• For arrays, proc is called with each element as the first paramater to proc, and the NULL object as the second parameter. Array elements are enumerated in ascending order of index.

• For streams, proc is called once, with the stream's dictionary as the first parameter to the proc and the NULL object as the second parameter.

# PDFDict Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict

```csharp
class PDFDict : PDFObject
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md)

## Description

Represents an associative collection of data elements within a PDF document.

All objects in a PDF document are built from a collection of simpler objects that represent fundamental datatypes like numbers, strings and arrays. PDFObject and its subclasses allow direct access and manipulation of these simple objects. Some subclasses represent single data elements, such as PDFInteger, which represents a single integer value. Other subclasses represent a collection of PDFObjects, like PDFArray, an indexed array of data elements.

A PDFDict is a heterogenous collection object that maps other PDFObjects (including other PDFDicts) to PDFName objects.

# PDFInteger Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFInteger

```csharp
class PDFInteger : PDFObject
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md)

## Description

Represents an integer data element within a PDF document.

All objects in a PDF document are built from a collection of simpler objects that represent fundamental datatypes like numbers, strings and arrays. PDFObject and its subclasses allow direct access and manipulation of these simple objects. Some subclasses represent single data elements. For example, PDFInteger represents a single integer value. Others represent a collection of PDFObjects, such as PDFArray, an indexed array of data elements.

A PDFInteger represents a single integer value, and may be inserted into any collection object.

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md), [`PDFObjectComparison`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFObjectComparison.md), [`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)

### EnumPDFObjects

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFObject.EnumPDFObjects(PDFObjectEnumProc enumProc)
```

**Parameters**

- `enumProc` ([`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)): A user-supplied callback to call for each element of the object. of obj. Neither proc nor any routine called by proc may modify the object. Doing so can produce undefined results or errors. For example, if the object is an array, enumProc must not call Remove(); if the object is a dictionary, enumProc must not call Put().

**Returns:** `bool`

Returns true if every call to enumProc returned true. As soon as any call to enumProc returns false, the enumeration stops and EnumPDFObject() returns false.

Enumerates the elements of a PDFObject by calling a user-supplied procedure for each component of the object.

• For scalars or strings, the proc is not called, and CosObjEnum() returns true.

• For dictionaries, proc is called for each key-value pair. The order in which the key-value pairs are enumerated is undefined.

• For arrays, proc is called with each element as the first paramater to proc, and the NULL object as the second parameter. Array elements are enumerated in ascending order of index.

• For streams, proc is called once, with the stream's dictionary as the first parameter to the proc and the NULL object as the second parameter.

# PDFName Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFName

```csharp
class PDFName : PDFObject
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md)

## Description

Represents a name data element within a PDF document.

All objects in a PDF document are built from a collection of simpler objects that represent fundamental datatypes like numbers, strings and arrays. PDFObject and its subclasses allow direct access and manipulation of these simple objects. Some subclasses represent single data elements. For example, PDFName represents a single name value. Others represent a collection of PDFObjects, such as PDFArray, an indexed array of data elements.

A PDFName represents a single indivisible name token, and may be inserted into any collection object. It may also be used as a key in a PDFDictionary.

**Referenced by:** [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md)

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md), [`PDFObjectComparison`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFObjectComparison.md), [`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)

# PDFObject Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject

```csharp
class PDFObject : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

**Derived classes:** [`PDFArray`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFArray.md), [`PDFBoolean`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFBoolean.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md), [`PDFInteger`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFInteger.md), [`PDFName`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFName.md), [`PDFReal`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFReal.md), [`PDFStream`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFStream.md), [`PDFString`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFString.md)

## Description

Represents the underlying simple data element of an object in a PDF document.

All objects in a PDF document are built from a collection of simpler objects that represent fundamental datatypes like numbers, strings and arrays. PDFObject and its subclasses allow direct access and manipulation of these simple objects. Some subclasses represent single data elements. For example, PDFInteger represents a single integer value. Others represent a collection of PDFObjects, such as PDFArray, an indexed array of data elements.

PDFObject is the superclass of these simple objects. A PDFObject cannot be directly instantiated, but any of its subclasses may.

Any PDFObject may be either direct or indirect. A direct object exists within its collection object (such as a PDFArray) and can be referenced only within that collection object. An indirect object exists outside of any collection object and can be referenced by many collection objects.

### EnumPDFObjects

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFObject.EnumPDFObjects(PDFObjectEnumProc enumProc)
```

**Parameters**

- `enumProc` ([`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)): A user-supplied callback to call for each element of the object. of obj. Neither proc nor any routine called by proc may modify the object. Doing so can produce undefined results or errors. For example, if the object is an array, enumProc must not call Remove(); if the object is a dictionary, enumProc must not call Put().

**Returns:** `bool`

Returns true if every call to enumProc returned true. As soon as any call to enumProc returns false, the enumeration stops and EnumPDFObject() returns false.

Enumerates the elements of a PDFObject by calling a user-supplied procedure for each component of the object.

• For scalars or strings, the proc is not called, and CosObjEnum() returns true.

• For dictionaries, proc is called for each key-value pair. The order in which the key-value pairs are enumerated is undefined.

• For arrays, proc is called with each element as the first paramater to proc, and the NULL object as the second parameter. Array elements are enumerated in ascending order of index.

• For streams, proc is called once, with the stream's dictionary as the first parameter to the proc and the NULL object as the second parameter.

# PDFObjectComparison Enum

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Comparisons between two PDFObjects.

Represents the result of comparing two PDFObject instances for ordering purposes.

## Values

- `Less = 0`: The first object is ordered before the second object.
- `Equal = 1`: The two objects are equal.
- `Greater = 2`: The first object is ordered after the second object.

# PDFObjectEnumProc Class

```csharp
class PDFObjectEnumProc : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Represents callback function for Document.EnumIndirectPDFObjects & PDFObject.Enum.

Enum is short for Enumerate. The class considers a list of indirect PDF objects. The callback function calls each object, and considers each object one by one, and continues to call and review each object until it finds and selects the object that is needed.

# PDFOptimizationCompressQuality Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFOptimizationCompressQuality

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Specifies the quality level for lossy image compression during PDF optimization.

Higher quality values produce larger files with better visual fidelity.

## Values

- `PDFOptimizerCompressQualityUnset = 0`: Quality has not been set; the optimizer will use its default.
- `PDFOptimizerCompressMinimum = 1`: Minimum quality, resulting in the smallest file size.
- `PDFOptimizerCompressLowQuality = 2`: Low quality compression.
- `PDFOptimizerCompressMediumQuality = 3`: Medium quality compression, balancing size and fidelity.
- `PDFOptimizerCompressHighQuality = 4`: High quality compression.
- `PDFOptimizerCompressMaximumQuality = 5`: Maximum quality compression, resulting in the largest file size among lossy options.
- `PDFOptimizerCompressLossless = 6`: Lossless compression, preserving the original image data exactly.

---

# PDFOptimizerCompressImageType Enum

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Specifies the category of images to target during PDF optimization compression.

## Values

- `PDFOptimizerColor = 1`: Target color images for compression.
- `PDFOptimizerGray = 2`: Target grayscale images for compression.
- `PDFOptimizerMonochrome = 3`: Target monochrome (black and white) images for compression.

---

# PDFOptimizerCompressionType Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFOptimizerCompressionType

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Specifies the compression algorithm to use when recompressing images during PDF optimization.

## Values

- `PDFOptimizerRecompressNone = 0`: Do not recompress. Used only when the original image is not compressed.
- `PDFOptimizerRecompressSame = 1`: Recompress using the same compression as the original image.
- `PDFOptimizerRecompressFlate = 2`: Recompress the image using Flate (zip/deflate) compression.
- `PDFOptimizerRecompressJpeg = 3`: Recompress the image using JPEG compression.
- `PDFOptimizerRecompressJP2k = 4`: Recompress the image using JPEG 2000 compression.
- `PDFOptimizerRecompressJBig = 5`: Recompress the image using JBIG2 compression.
- `PDFOptimizerRecompressCCITTG4 = 6`: Recompress the image using CCITT Group 4 compression.
- `PDFOptimizerRecompressCCITTG3 = 7`: Recompress the image using CCITT Group 3 compression.
- `PDFOptimizerRecompressFlateJpeg = 8`: Recompress using Flate for lossless portions and JPEG for lossy portions.

---

# PDFOptimizerObjectCompressionType Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFOptimizerObjectCompressionType

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Specifies the object-level stream compression strategy during PDF optimization.

## Values

- `PDFOptimizerObjectCompressionAll = 0`: Compress all objects into object streams.
- `PDFOptimizerObjectCompressionNone = 1`: Do not use object stream compression for any objects.
- `PDFOptimizerObjectCompressionStructure = 2`: Compress only document structure objects into object streams.
- `PDFOptimizerObjectCompressionLeaveUnchanged = 3`: Leave the existing object compression unchanged.

# PDFReal Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFReal

```csharp
class PDFReal : PDFObject
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md)

## Description

Represents a floating point data element within a PDF document.

All objects in a PDF document are built from a collection of simpler objects that represent fundamental datatypes like numbers, strings and arrays. PDFObject and its subclasses allow direct access and manipulation of these simple objects. Some subclasses represent single data elements. For example, PDFReal represents a single floating point value. Others represent a collection of PDFObjects, such as PDFArray, an indexed array of data elements.

A PDFReal represents a single floating point value, and may be inserted into any collection object.

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md), [`PDFObjectComparison`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFObjectComparison.md), [`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)

### EnumPDFObjects

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFObject.EnumPDFObjects(PDFObjectEnumProc enumProc)
```

**Parameters**

- `enumProc` ([`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)): A user-supplied callback to call for each element of the object. of obj. Neither proc nor any routine called by proc may modify the object. Doing so can produce undefined results or errors. For example, if the object is an array, enumProc must not call Remove(); if the object is a dictionary, enumProc must not call Put().

**Returns:** `bool`

Returns true if every call to enumProc returned true. As soon as any call to enumProc returns false, the enumeration stops and EnumPDFObject() returns false.

Enumerates the elements of a PDFObject by calling a user-supplied procedure for each component of the object.

• For scalars or strings, the proc is not called, and CosObjEnum() returns true.

• For dictionaries, proc is called for each key-value pair. The order in which the key-value pairs are enumerated is undefined.

• For arrays, proc is called with each element as the first paramater to proc, and the NULL object as the second parameter. Array elements are enumerated in ascending order of index.

• For streams, proc is called once, with the stream's dictionary as the first parameter to the proc and the NULL object as the second parameter.

# PDFStream Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFStream

```csharp
class PDFStream : PDFObject
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md)

## Description

Represents a stream of data within a PDF document.

All objects in a PDF document are built from a collection of simpler objects that represent fundamental datatypes like numbers, strings and arrays.

PDFObject and its subclasses allow direct access and manipulation of these simple objects. Some subclasses represent single data elements (e.g. PDFInteger represents a single integer value); other subclasses represent a collection of PDFObjects (e.g. PDFArray is an indexed array of data elements).

A PDFStream represents a stream of unsigned bytes, and may be inserted into any collection object. It includes a dictionary that describes how the data in the stream is encoded and other useful information about the stream. A PDFStream is always an indirect object.

PDFStreams can be encoded using built-in filters. These filters include compression schemes for most popular image formats, and text encoding translators to permit safe transmission of the document over the Internet. The data in a PDFStream will be automatically encoded when it is created; the user can read either the encoded (raw) or decoded (filtered) data.

PDFStreams can be used for any large collection of data that need not be read into memory all at once, including image data, multimedia data or XML markup.

**Referenced by:** [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md), [`ICCBasedColorSpace`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/ICCBasedColorSpace.md), [`Image`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Image.md), [`PostScript`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PostScript.md), [`PostScriptCalculatorFunction`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PostScriptCalculatorFunction.md)

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`PDFArray`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFArray.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md), [`PDFObjectComparison`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFObjectComparison.md), [`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md), [`PDFStreamOpenMode`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFStreamOpenMode.md)

Enumerates the elements of a PDFObject by calling a user-supplied procedure for each component of the object.

• For scalars or strings, the proc is not called, and CosObjEnum() returns true.

• For dictionaries, proc is called for each key-value pair. The order in which the key-value pairs are enumerated is undefined.

• For arrays, proc is called with each element as the first paramater to proc, and the NULL object as the second parameter. Array elements are enumerated in ascending order of index.

• For streams, proc is called once, with the stream's dictionary as the first parameter to the proc and the NULL object as the second parameter.

# PDFString Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFString

```csharp
class PDFString : PDFObject
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md)

## Description

Represents an array of unsigned bytes within a PDF document.

A PDFString is a single data element that represents an array of unsigned bytes. It may be inserted into any collection object. PDFString may be a string of human readable text, but this is not required, and it may be stored either as characters or as hex values.

**Referenced by:** [`NameTree`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/NameTree.md)

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`PDFObject`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObject.md), [`PDFObjectComparison`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PDFObjectComparison.md), [`PDFObjectEnumProc`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFObjectEnumProc.md)

Neither proc nor any routine called by proc may modify the object. Doing so can produce undefined results or errors. **Returns:** `bool`

Enumerates the elements of a PDFObject by calling a user-supplied procedure for each component of the object.

• For scalars or strings, the proc is not called, and CosObjEnum() returns true.

• For dictionaries, proc is called for each key-value pair. The order in which the key-value pairs are enumerated is undefined.

• For arrays, proc is called with each element as the first paramater to proc, and the NULL object as the second parameter. Array elements are enumerated in ascending order of index.

• For streams, proc is called once, with the stream's dictionary as the first parameter to the proc and the NULL object as the second parameter.

```csharp
class PDFXConvertParams : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Parameters for converting a document to PDF/X compliance.

These parameters control how a Document is converted to the PDF/X standard.

**Referenced by:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)

### PDFXConvertParams

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.PDFXConvertParams.PDFXConvertParams(bool RemoveAllAnnotations, bool AbortIfXFAIsPresent)
```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `RemoveAllAnnotations` (`bool`): Remove all annotations whether legal or illegal.
- `AbortIfXFAIsPresent` (`bool`): Abort when XFA is present.

Parameters for converting to PDF/X.

## Properties

### AbortIfXFAIsPresent

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFXConvertParams.AbortIfXFAIsPresent { get; set; }
```

Gets whether conversion is aborted when XFA forms are present.

Presence of XFA can result in some loss of data in output PDF/X file as the Library does not support XFA. However client can choose to abort the conversion in case XFA is present by setting this parameter to true.

By default we will not abort if XFA is present.

If false we will convert even if we detect the XFA form entry in PDDoc. If true we will abort the process.

### ProfileDesc

```csharp
string Datalogics.PDFL.PDFXConvertParams.ProfileDesc { get; set; }
```

Gets the Output Intent profile description for the PDF/X conversion.

The Output Intent of a PDF/X document may be any valid CMYK Profile For PDF/X-1a or any valid CMYK or RGB Profile for PDF/X-3. This parameter allows the user to specify a particular profile for this conversion by description. When this parameter is not present, the profile "U.S. Web Coated (SWOP) v2" will be used for both.

If this description is present, and specifies a profile of the wrong color family, or specifies a profile which cannot be located in resources, an exception will be raised.

### RemoveAllAnnotations

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.PDFXConvertParams.RemoveAllAnnotations { get; set; }
```

Gets whether all annotations and actions are removed during conversion.

Some of the standards like PDF/X prohibit the presence of some types of Annotations and Actions in order to comply with those standards.

By default we will filter all illegal Annotations and Actions.

If false we will filter out all illegal Annotations and Actions (according to the standard being used) while retaining the legal ones. If true this will remove all the Annotations and Actions from the output PDF/X compliant file.


# PDFXConvertResult Class

```csharp
class PDFXConvertResult
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

Contains a PDF document if the conversion is successful; returns null if the conversion fails.

PDF/X is a subset of the PDF ISO standard. The purpose of PDF/X is to facilitate graphics exchange, and it therefore has a series of printing related requirements. For example, in PDF/X-1a all fonts need to be embedded and all images need to be CMYK or spot colors. PDF/X-3 accepts calibrated RGB and CIELAB colors.

**Referenced by:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)

# PermissionFlags Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PermissionFlags

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Values

- `None = 0`: The document has no security data.
- `Open = 0x01`: The user can open and decrypt the document.
- `Secure = 0x02`: The user can change the document's security settings.
- `Print = 0x04`: The user can print the document. Page Setup access is unaffected by this permission, since that affects PDF Viewer's preferences - not the document's. In the Document Security dialog, this corresponds to the Printing entry.
- `Edit = 0x08`: The user can edit the document more than adding or modifying text notes (see also EditNotes). In the Document Security dialog, this corresponds to the Changing the Document entry.
- `Copy = 0x10`: The user can copy information from the document to the clipboard. In the document restrictions, this corresponds to the Content Copying or Extraction entry.
- `EditNotes = 0x20`: The user can add, modify, and delete text notes (see also Edit). In the document restrictions, this corresponds to the Authoring Comments and Form Fields entry.
- `SaveAs = 0x40`: The user can perform a Save As.... If both Edit and EditNotes are disallowed, Save will be disabled but Save As... will be enabled. The Save As... menu item is not necessarily disabled even if the user is not permitted to perform a Save As....
- `Ext = 0x80`: Extended permission for document operations beyond the base set.
- `FillandSign = 0x100`: Overrides other Permissions bits. It allows the user to fill in or sign existing form or signature fields.
- `Accessible = 0x200`: Overrides Copy to enable the Accessibility API. If a document is saved in Rev2 format (Acrobat 4.0 compatible), only the Copy bit is checked to determine the Accessibility API state.
- `DocAssembly = 0x400`: Overrides various Edit bits and allows the following operations: page insert/delete/rotate and create bookmark and thumbnail.
- `HighPrint = 0x800`: This bit is a supplement to Print. If it is clear (disabled) only low quality printing (Print As Image) is allowed. On UNIX platforms where Print As Image doesn't exist, printing is disabled.
- `Owner = 0x8000`: The user is permitted to perform all operations, regardless of the permissions specified by the document. Unless this permission is set, the document's permissions will be reset to those in the document after a full save.
- `FormSubmit = 0x10000`: This should be set if the user can submit forms outside of the browser. This bit is a supplement to FillandSign.
- `FormSpawnTempl = 0x20000`: This should be set if the user can spawn template pages. This bit will allow page template spawning even if Edit and EditNotes are clear.
- `All = -1`: All permissions granted, combining all individual permission flags.
- `Settable = 60`: The OR of all operations that can be set by the user in the security restrictions (Print + Edit + Copy + EditNotes).
- `User = -4`: All permissions.

---

# PermissionRequestOperation Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/PermissionRequestOperation

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Values

- `AllOperations = 1`: Check all operations.
- `Create = 2`: Generic.
- `Delete = 3`: Delete.
- `Modify = 4`: Modify.
- `Copy = 5`: Copy.
- `Accessible = 6`: For accessibility use.
- `Select = 7`: For document or page, selecting (not copying) text or graphics.
- `Open = 8`: For document open.
- `Secure = 9`: For the document: changing security settings.
- `PrintHigh = 10`: For the document: regular printing.
- `PrintLow = 11`: For the document: low quality printing.
- `FillIn = 12`: Form fill-in, or sign the existing field.
- `Rotate = 13`: Rotate.
- `Crop = 14`: Crop.
- `Summarize = 15`: For summarizing notes.
- `Insert = 16`: Insert.
- `Replace = 17`: For the page.
- `Reorder = 18`: For the page.
- `FullSave = 19`: For the document.
- `Import = 20`: For the notes and image.
- `Export = 21`: For the notes. ExportPS should check print.
- `AnyOperation = 22`: Used for checking to see if any operation is allowed.
- `UnknownOperation = 23`: Used for error checking.
- `SubmitStandalone = 24`: Submit forms outside of the browser.
- `SpawnTemplate = 25`: Allow the form to spawn template pages.
- `Online = 26`: This should be always the last item For annotations and forms: enabling online functionality.
- `SummaryView = 27`: For annotations: enabling a summary view of annotations in a PDF Viewer.
- `BarcodePlaintext = 28`: For forms: enables form appearance to be rendered as a plain text barcode.

# Point Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Point

```csharp
class Point : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Represents a discrete point or space in a PDF.

A Point in a PDF document is in the right plane, relative to the origin being the lower left corner of the document.

**Referenced by:** [`AxialShadingPattern`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/AxialShadingPattern.md), [`CurveTo`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/CurveTo.md), [`CurveToV`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/CurveToV.md), [`CurveToY`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/CurveToY.md), [`InkAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/InkAnnotation.md), [`LineAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LineAnnotation.md), [`LineTo`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LineTo.md), [`LinkAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/LinkAnnotation.md), [`MoveTo`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/MoveTo.md), [`Path`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Path.md), [`Point`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Point.md), [`PolyLineAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PolyLineAnnotation.md), [`PolygonAnnotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PolygonAnnotation.md), [`Quad`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Quad.md), [`RectSegment`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/RectSegment.md), [`Text`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Text.md)

# PolygonAnnotation Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PolygonAnnotation

```csharp
class PolygonAnnotation : Annotation
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Annotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Annotation.md)

## Description

A polygon is a closed plane figure bounded by a finite number of line segments.

In this case the polygon is created as an annotation added to a PDF file.

**Uses types:** [`AnnotationFlags`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/AnnotationFlags.md), [`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md), [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md), [`OptionalContentContext`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentContext.md), [`OptionalContentMembershipDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentMembershipDict.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md), [`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md), [`Point`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Point.md), [`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md)

## Constructors


### IsCurrentlyVisible

```csharp
bool Datalogics.PDFL.Annotation.IsCurrentlyVisible(OptionalContentContext occ)
```

**Parameters**

- `occ` ([`OptionalContentContext`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentContext.md)): The optional content context in which to check visibility.

**Returns:** `bool`

true if the annotation is currently visible.

Tests whether an annotation is visible in a given optional content context, considering the current ON-OFF states of the optional-content groups in the optional-content dictionary (OCMD) and the dictionary's visibility policy.

If the annotation occurs more than once within the content, this method only checks the visibility of the first occurrence of the annotation.

This method determines visibility without considering the visbility of the Content object that the annotation belongs to. To determine the visibility of an annotation while taking the Content's visibility into consideration, use the alternate version of this method.

# PolyLineAnnotation Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PolyLineAnnotation

```csharp
class PolyLineAnnotation : Annotation
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** [`Annotation`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Annotation.md)

## Description

A finite number of line segments in a PDF added as an annotation.

A polyline is also called a polygonal chain or piecewise linear curve. It represents a finite number of line segments where the first and last vertex are not connected. In this case, the polyline is added as an annotation to a PDF file.

**Uses types:** [`AnnotationFlags`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/AnnotationFlags.md), [`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md), [`Form`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Form.md), [`LineEndingStyle`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/LineEndingStyle.md), [`OptionalContentContext`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentContext.md), [`OptionalContentMembershipDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/OptionalContentMembershipDict.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md), [`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md), [`Point`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Point.md), [`Rect`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Rect.md)

Tests whether an annotation is visible in a given optional content context, considering the current ON-OFF states of the optional-content groups in the optional-content dictionary (OCMD) and the dictionary's visibility policy.

If the annotation occurs more than once within the content, this method only checks the visibility of the first occurrence of the annotation.

This method determines visibility without considering the visbility of the Content object that the annotation belongs to. To determine the visibility of an annotation while taking the Content's visibility into consideration, use the alternate version of this method.

### ToString

```csharp
override string Datalogics.PDFL.Annotation.ToString()
```

**Returns:** `override string`

A string describing this annotation, including its type and rectangle.

Returns a string representation of this annotation.

## Description

An XObject stream with the subtype PostScript.

A PostScript XObject is an XObject stream with the subtype entry of PostScript. The XObject contains a fragment of code expressed in the PostScript language.

# PrintCancelProc Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PrintCancelProc

```csharp
class PrintCancelProc : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

Print cancellation callback function, a class used to cancel print operations.

A PrintCancelProc() is typically passed to some method that takes a long time to complete. At frequent intervals, the method calls the PrintCancelProc().

If the PrintCancelProc() returns true, the method cancels its operation; if the PrintCancelProc() returns false, the method continues.

**Referenced by:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)

# PrintUserParams Class

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PrintUserParams

```csharp
class PrintUserParams : SystemIDisposable
```

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

**Inherits from:** `SystemIDisposable`

## Description

A structure used to set parameters for print jobs.

Two structures provide settings for setting parameters for print jobs, PrintUserParams and PrintParams. PrintUserParams was created first, and then PrintParams was created as an extension of PrintUserParams, to provide more settings to account for changing technology.

When the system seeks to print a document it will pass the content and the print parameters, such as the page size, paper tray, and landscape v. portrait, to the print API in APDFL. If the setting is in PrintParams it will pass the document and parameters to PrintParams and then to PrintUserParams and from there to the print API to complete the printing process.

The print logic may take different code paths depending on whether or not the print content is being sent to a printer or to a file, or if the printing uses PostScript or not. When you see a print setting that appears in both PrintUserParams and PrintParams, such as "ShrinktoFit," set the appropriate value in both of these classes. Also, PrintParams offers a variety of settings related to PostScript, but the use of PrintParams is not limited to PostScript.

**Referenced by:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md)

**Uses types:** [`Document`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Document.md), [`FarEastFont`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/FarEastFont.md), [`PrintParams`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PrintParams.md)

## Constructors

```csharp

```

*constructor*

Constructs a PrintUserParams with default settings.

Initializes the print parameters to default values: paper size set to use the media box, emit to printer enabled, emit to file disabled, and zero copies. On macOS, also initializes the system print session, print settings, and page format.

## Methods

### ChoosePaperSourceBySize

```csharp
void Datalogics.PDFL.PrintUserParams.ChoosePaperSourceBySize(double width, double height)
```

**Parameters**

- `width` (`double`): the desired width of the output in user units
- `height` (`double`): the desired height of the output in user units

**Returns:** `void`

Choose the best paper source for a given width and height.

Searches the printer's paper list for the smallest paper size that is greater than or equal to the given width and height, including with rotation, and sets up the job to print with that paper size.

To obtain width and height, specify the Right - Left and Top - Bottom of the MediaBox of a representative Page.

The printerName and portName must be set.

If you use this call in conjunction with PosePrintDialog, UseDefaultPrinter, or UpdateFromPrinterSettings, call this function after those functions.

Setting RotateAndCenter to True is recommended with this function.

# QRErrorCorrectionLevel Enum

Source: https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/enum/QRErrorCorrectionLevel

**Namespace:** `Datalogics::PDFL`

## Description

The Error Correction Level of the QR Code

## Values

- `Low = 0`: Can tolerate 7% of bad codewords.
- `Medium = 1`: Can tolerate 15% of bad codewords.
- `Quartile = 2`: Can tolerate 25% of bad codewords.
- `High = 3`: Can tolerate 30% of bad codewords.

## Description

A rect holds four coordinates for a rectangle.

When many redactions are to be created, the option using a font object in place of the font name is preferred.

**Parameters**

- `page` ([`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md)): The page where this redaction mark is found.
- `regions` ([`System.Collections.Generic.IList< Quad >`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Quad.md)): A vector of quadrilateral regions specifying the redaction's bounds, specified in user space coordinates.
- `internalColor` ([`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md)): The color of the redaction mark. This color is also used as the fill color when generating the replacement form for this redaction mark. The replacement form is the content that will be placed on the page when this mark is applied and the underlying content is removed.
- `fillRedacted` (`bool`): When true, the area being redacted will be filled with the internalColor in the redacted appearance (and in the final document, after redactions are applied). This parameter is considered true if not omitted.
- `drawBorder` (`bool`): When true, the "normal" appearance of the redacted areas will have a border of 1 point, in the borderColor. When it is false, no border will be drawn. This parameter is considered true if not omitted.
- `borderColor` ([`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md)): The color to draw the border around the "normal" appearance of each area. If omitted, and fillColor is not omitted, no border will be drawn. If both fillColor and BorderColor is omitted, border will be drawn in internalColor. If internalColor is also omitted, border will be drawn in black.
- `fillNormal` (`bool`): When true, the areas being redacted will be drawn, in the "normal" appearance, with an overlaying fill of the fillColor at the fillOpacity. When false, there will be no overlay fill. This paramter is considered false if omitted.
- `fillColor` ([`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md)): The color applied as an overlay to the "normal" (Non redacted) area within the redaction areas. If this color is omitted, a "white" fill will be presumed.
- `fillOpacity` (`double`): A value from 0 to 1.0 which is the opacity of the fill color (If this value is one, then the content of the redacted area will not be visible in the "normal" mode. If it is zero, then there will be no visible color overlaying the content to be redacted). If omitted, this will default to 1.0.
- `overlayText` (`string`): The value of the string to be displayed over the redacted area. It will be scaled and/or repeated according to the value of later parameters. If omitted, it will be an empty string, and there will be no overlay text drawn.
- `textColor` ([`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md)): The color to use in drawing the OverlayText. If this is omitted, white will be presumed.
- `fontName` (`string`): The name of the font to be used when setting the overlayText. When absent or empty, the standard font Helvtica will be used. Using this option, a new internal font is created for each redaction. Each is subset and embedded. When many, many redactions are to be created, this can result in a significant use of processing time. When many redactions are to be created, the option using a font object in place of the font name is preferred.
- `textSize` (`double`): The size, in points, to draw the text too. This may be overridden the scaleTofit value below. If omitted, it will default to 12.0.

Create a new Redaction annotation object with extended options. When Overlay Text is used, font is specified by name. To create a potental redaction and place it elsewhere in the page's annotation array.

```csharp
Datalogics.PDFL.Redaction.Redaction(Page page, System.Collections.Generic.IList< Quad > regions, Font font)
```

*constructor*

**Parameters**

- `page` ([`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md)): The page where this redaction mark is found.
- `regions` ([`System.Collections.Generic.IList< Quad >`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Quad.md)): A vector of quadrilateral regions specifying the redaction's bounds, specified in user space coordinates.
- `font` ([`Font`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Font.md)): The font to be used when creating overlay text. For most efficiency, this font should be created prior to the first redaction, and used for all redactions. After the last redaction is created the font may be subset and embedded. Using this option, rather than specifying a font name, significantly speeds the creation of many redactions.

**Parameters**

- `page` ([`Page`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Page.md)): The page where this redaction mark is found.
- `regions` ([`System.Collections.Generic.IList< Quad >`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Quad.md)): A vector of quadrilateral regions specifying the redaction's bounds, specified in user space coordinates.
- `font` ([`Font`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Font.md)): The font to be used when creating overlay text. For most efficiency, this font should be created prior to the first redaction, and used for all redactions. After the last redaction is created the font may be subset and embedded. Using this option, rather than specifying a font name, significantly speeds the creation of many redactions.
- `internalColor` ([`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md)): The color of the redaction mark. This color is also used as the fill color when generating the replacement form for this redaction mark. The replacement form is the content that will be placed on the page when this mark is applied and the underlying content is removed.
- `fillRedacted` (`bool`): When true, the area being redacted will be filled with the internalColor in the redacted appearance(and in the final
  document, after redactions are applied). If omitted, this parameter will default to true.
- `drawBorder` (`bool`): When true, the "normal" appearance of the redacted areas will have a border of 1 point, in the borderColor. When it is false, no border will be drawn. If omitted, this parameter will default to true.
- `borderColor` ([`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md)): The color to draw the border around the "normal" appearance of each area. If omitted, and fillColor is not omitted, no border will be drawn. If both fillColor and BorderColor is omitted, border will be drawn in internalColor. If internalColor is also omitted, border will be drawn in black.
- `fillNormal` (`bool`): When true, the areas being redacted will be drawn, in the "normal" appearance, with an overlaying fill of the fillColor at the fillOpacity. When false, there will be no overlay fill. This paramter is considered false if omitted.
- `fillColor` ([`Color`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/Color.md)): The color applied as an overlay to the "normal" (Non redacted) area within the redaction areas. If this color is omitted, a "white" fill will be presumed.
- `fillOpacity` (`double`): A value from 0 to 1.0 which is the opacity of the fill color(If this value is one, then the content of the redacted area will not be visible in the "normal" mode. If it is zero, then there will be no visible color overlaying the content to be redacted). If omitted, this will default to 1.0.

Create a new Redaction annotation object with extended options .When Overlay Text is used, font is provided as a font. To create a potental redaction and place it elsewhere in the page's annotation array.

The OptionalContentMembershipDict property for this Annotation.

## Description

A remote go-to action is an action that includes a RemoteDestination object.

The action associated with this object, when selected, opens a separate PDF file, or opens a web page in a browser window.

**Uses types:** [`FileSpecification`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/FileSpecification.md), [`PDFDict`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/PDFDict.md), [`RemoteDestination`](https://docs.datalogics.com/apdfl21/DotNetFramework/APDFL21.0.0PlusP1e/class/RemoteDestination.md)

